Amidst the bustling crowds at Bondi, two men start drowning at the north end. Californian bodybuilder Ike Catcher arrives to challenge Harries for the 'King-of-Bondi' title. The real King-of-Bondi test is the annual lifeguard challenge, when everyone races to decide which lifeguard is the fastest.

Russian body builder Dimitri breaks both legs after he plunges down the cliff at North Bondi. A learner paddleboarder snaps her collar bone in the shore break. And Chappo's rescue skills in the South Corner earn him the title 'Chappo's Corner'. But one veteran lifeguard is having none of it.

A car free falls off a ledge onto a busy walking track. A man harassing women on the beach flees from police, who require a helicopter, boat and jetski to catch him. Joel enlists his ironman champion brother, Matt Bevilacqua, to aid him in the Annual Lifeguard Race.

Two brothers survive a lightning strike using resuscitation techniques learned from Bondi Rescue. Veteran lifeguard Whippet rescues two men simultaneously. Singlets treats a boy for a potential spinal injury, recalling his own son's similar injury two years prior. Gavin bogs the buggy at pack-up.

A boy goes missing in the water. As lifeguards search desperately, the boy's mother breaks down convinced her son has drowned. At the south end a man screams in pain from a dislocated hip, but lifeguards Beardy and Harrison are taken by surprise when the man's friend has a seizure just metres away.

Bra Boy Jesse rescues a vicious rat from the skate bowl, lifeguards play detectives after a punch-up in the surf break, and Harries swims more than a kilometre out to sea. None of this is in the lifeguard manual, but the boys tackle it with lifeguard ingenuity and a healthy dose of humour.

Beloved Bondi lifeguard Maxi risks his life to rescue two fishermen from an overturned boat in challenging seas. Jethro is angry after rescuing tourists he had warned about rips, then later collapses on the beach. Luke Daniels rides a wave using the oldest surfboard design in the world.
The lifeguards put their lives on the line in the annual lifeguard challenge. Tommy gets bad news about his father's health, and pulls a beginner swimmer to safety.

The Rooster NRL team go surfing with lifeguards, but run over Yatesy on a rescue board, breaking his ribs and puncturing his lung. Quinn attends to a teenage girl with a broken nose and shattered vanity. A rescue proves difficult when Luke learns his female patient is deaf.

New trainee Tommy volunteers to catch a deadly sea snake. Christmas brings an influx of tourists to Bondi. Kerrbox plays Santa, and kids search for him on the beach with the help of Harrison. Jesse clears the water as a man is found unresponsive.

Jack and Azza race to the aid of a young surfer on the shoreline who insists he hasn't been in the water even though he's dripping wet. Maxi, normally one of the nice guys, has to lay down the law when he rescues two patients who don't cooperate.

A group of monks go missing on Bondi. Lachie rescues, then loses hold of, a young Norwegian who girl who sinks in front of him. A blue bottle sting on a 38 year old tourist becomes an anaphylactic shock and serious medical emergency. A young cancer patient gets to become a 'lifeguard for the day'.

In the most powerful episode ever, two people from the same family drown. The remaining family members watch as lifeguards attempt to resuscitate them, marking a crisis not faced by lifeguards since 1939.
Jesse saves an American tourist from calm waters, combined with a collective CPR effort from the lifeguards, the paramedics, and the Jewish Medical Response team.

A bluebottle attack turns the Bondi tower into a makeshift emergency ward. A tourist is stung mid-rescue. Lifeguards share a wave with blind surfer Derek Rabelo. Mouse handles the tower with a missing boy, a man with a dislocated shoulder, and a young woman overdosing on drugs.

programmes.t: I Turned Myself into the Little Mermaid!
programmes.d: Guest host Christina Wilson takes a whimsical dive into mermaid life, transforming underwater for a hilarious and oddly educational aquatic adventure.The batfish looks like something from another planet. Mark dives to find this awkward but fascinating creature of the ocean floor.

The spiny lobster's claws may look small, but one swipe slices skin. Coyote takes a cut and explains this crustacean's anatomy.Tarpon are giant, fast, and aggressive. Coyote gets up close—and briefly inside—during this wild feeding encounter in the water.

The fireworm burns without flame. Mark handles this stinging marine creature and ends up with a fiery rash to prove it.Ever wondered what a thousand mosquito bites look like? Coyote offers his arms as bait and explores how mosquitoes affect humans and ecosystems.

Coyote tests an underwater jetpack, soaring through the ocean and meeting sea life in this high-speed dive adventure you have to see to believe!This emotional episode follows chimpanzees rescued from testing labs as they adapt to new lives of freedom and care.

programmes.t: I Found the World's Smartest Octopus! (Wonderpus)
programmes.d: Mark meets the Wonderpus octopus, a master of camouflage and cognition. This episode is part science lesson, part magical underwater journey.Buried in the sand lies a nightmare: the bobbit worm. Mark reveals this hidden predator's lightning-fast strike and bizarre anatomy.

Massive and prehistoric-looking, this lizard is nicknamed ‘Godzilla' for a reason. Mark tracks it down in its wild habitat.Mark takes a direct sting from the infamous Asian giant hornet. With swelling, pain, and drama, it's one of his most talked-about encounters ever.

This episode features a painful sting from the electric caterpillar, a bizarre jungle dweller with venomous barbs. It's shocking—literally.A sting from Japan's meanest wasp! This aggressive insect doesn't hold back. Mark's reaction is both painful and fascinating.

programmes.t: Salamander Scavenger Hunt! – How Many Will We Find?!
programmes.d: Coyote leads a scavenger hunt to find as many salamanders as possible. With every flip of a log, a new amphibian awaits.Can a frog be poisonous *and* delicious? Coyote tries a legal and safe sample of a species known for its toxins and explains how toxicity works in the wild.

Coyote catches a brilliantly blue frog with a rare genetic mutation. He explains the science behind pigmentation and its survival impact.Coyote tests a supposed parasite cure on himself. Will this so-called kryptonite protect him from infestation? The results may surprise you.

A second sighting of the rare blue frog leaves Coyote stunned. The frog's vibrant coloration is even more incredible up close.Giant bloodworms have jaws and venom, and they're not shy about using either. Mark finds out the hard way.

programmes.t: Bitten by 3 Toxic Worms! (Which Is Worst?)
programmes.d: Three worms, three different toxins. Coyote compares the effects of each to determine which toxic worm inflicts the worst bite of all.Cold-stunned sea turtles wash ashore, helpless. Mark joins a rescue effort to revive and release these beautiful reptiles back to the ocean.

programmes.t: Squirting Clams Pulled Up from the Muck!
programmes.d: Clams that squirt? Mark explores tidal flats where strange mollusks shoot water as a defense mechanism. It's weirder than you think.Bloodworms have teeth and aren't afraid to use them. Mark gets bitten and reveals why these creepy crawlers are misunderstood.

programmes.t: Making a Crabby Tide Pool Aquarium in New England!
programmes.d: Mark builds a tide pool aquarium along the New England coast and fills it with crabs and marine critters. It's hands-on science at its best.The vampire fish lives up to its name. Coyote gets bitten and shows the terrifying teeth and feeding behavior of this river predator.

programmes.st: Up in the Air // AdDRESSing the Problem
programmes.d: Ling Ling is waiting for Rainbow Ruby, looking worried. It turns out that Mr. Sloth's best friend Chirpee is depressed. In Rainbow Village, people are busy preparing for a dance marathon, a competition in which all of the villagers participate. Ling Ling is very sad that Ellie decided not to participate. Ellie is not a confident dancer so she doesn't want to participate. // Rainbow Ruby's friends tell her that they are now friends with Felicia. They were playing hide and seek but Felicia is such a good hider that she's refused to come out even though she's won the game.

Kiki wants to become a movie actress but the villagers have no idea how to direct a movie. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to turn into a movie director. She then assigns roles to the village friends. // Ling Ling rushes toward Rainbow Ruby to tell her that a busy villager mom asked him to take care of her three children but he just doesn't have time to look after them. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to transform into a babysitter and starts babysitting the children.

programmes.st: Wakey Wakey // Rules of the Road
programmes.d: Princess Kiki is asleep, UP IN THE AIR! According to the note that Kiki left behind, a princess falls under a spell from time to time and in order to break it, they need to play the music box nearby Kiki. But the music box is broken. // Rainbow Ruby and Choco discover cars moving in every direction. Ling Ling asks Rainbow Ruby for help and she uses her magic suitcase to become a police officer.

Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that today is Noodle Festival day in the village but there is a problem. The problem is that the noodle tree, which grows noodles, decided to take a year off and is not growing any noodles this year. // Ling Ling and the friends are worried about the discouraged Gina. Gina just announced that she will stop doing somersaults anymore because she accidentally hurt her friends while practicing.

programmes.st: A Colorful Way to Cool Off // Seeing in Believing
programmes.d: Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that Rainbow Village friends were playing around the Rainbow fountain to cool off from the heat but water suddenly stopped coming out of the fountain. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a plumber and starts fixing the fountain. // Kiki's face has turned purple because she ate magical Plumen berries. Kiki accidentally picked magical Plumen berries instead of the delicious rainbow berries she was trying to gather.

programmes.st: Bad Hair Day // Ice is Nice
programmes.d: Ellie's and Jessy's hair are a complete mess after Felicia accidentally causes some Rainbow fruit to fall on them. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a hairdresser. // It's winter in Rainbow Village. Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that last night a huge ice mountain appeared so everyone is enjoying an ice sculpture festival. But Jessy seems to have a toothache.

The ground is all wet in Rainbow Village. What's going on? The friends tell Ruby that Jessy's tears have soaked the ground. Jessy accidentally ate Ellie's magic beans and became as huge as a giant. // Thunderbell is very sad because his best friend, Mr. Sloth, is angry at him. Rainbow Ruby thinks up the best way to apologize to Mr. Sloth, who loves performances. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a choreographer.

programmes.st: A Treasure Lost, A Treasure Found // Dazzling Dumplings
programmes.d: Thunderbell, Ellie, and Kiki are looking hard for something. It turns out that when Thunderbell was trying on Kiki's crown, he accidentally dropped it and a gem went missing. Kiki sadly says that a princess' crown is worthless without a jewel. // Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that this year they won't be able to enjoy the traditional rainbow dumplings as the recipe was accidentally torn to pieces. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a chef.

programmes.st: How Does Your Garden Grow // Mystery Gifts
programmes.d: Kiki wanted to make a nice garden so she asked the Poppies to do some gardening but they planted the seeds everywhere in the garden, making an absolute mess. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to turn into a gardener.// Ling Ling is setting up a 'Thankfulness' tree at the center of the town square. He tells Rainbow Ruby that he is going to hold an event where the village friends can write notes to people that they are thankful to and hang them up on the tree.

Rainbow Village friends are on a train and they are concerned that the train won't stop. The engine is even smoking! Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a firefighter. // Paige is extremely upset. It turns out that she's been preparing an awesome fashion show but now it had to be cancelled because Gina accidentally spilled a bunch of fruit onto the stage.

programmes.st: The Rainbow Wave // The Best Pet You Never Met
programmes.d: Rainbow Village friends are gathered together at the lake to surf on the Rainbow wave that only comes once a year and they need some help. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a lifeguard and helps her friends safely enjoy their surfing. // Thunderbell is looking extremely worried. It turns out that his pet fish has gone missing. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a detective and finds out Thunderbell's pet fish's whereabouts.

A welcome party for Prince Frederick is taking place in Rainbow Village, but the guest of honour isn't having any fun at all. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a party planner. // The village is a total mess from the paint that spilled from up above. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to turn into a clean-up engineer and starts cleaning with her friends.

programmes.st: Dolphin Dilemma // Ruby and the Beast
programmes.d: A Flower Festival is underway in Rainbow Village and Ling Ling has called Rainbow Ruby to help her judge the "best flower" contest. But just as Rainbow Ruby starts looking around at the flowers, Kiki's pet dog Pom Pom starts acting unusual and running around frantically, destroying the festival! // Gina and Jessy are with a huge fish that's injured by the lake. Rainbow Ruby becomes a Marine Biologist. Rainbow Ruby uses her encyclopedia to find out that the fish is actually a dolphin.

programmes.st: Learn How to Be Skinny from Usagi

programmes.st: The Girl Genius Is a Monster: The Brainwashing Cram School of Horror
programmes.d: Usagi befriends Ami Mizuno, the school's smartest girl, who has an IQ over 300. But Luna, who senses an unknown energy coming from Ami, suspects her of being a Monster.

programmes.st: Usagi's Disaster: Beware of the Clock of Confusion
programmes.d: Usagi and Ami go shopping, where they find a store selling a clock that resembles Luna. Usagi is happy to learn that her mother bought the same clock as a gift. That night, the clock emits a strange light that causes Usagi to become very impatient.

A hostage-taking crisis happens in the operating room. The victim at the edge of the knife is Seo Jung, with the sole request is to stop the surgery that currently takes place. The medical team informs the police, but the armed suspect is ready to kill Seo Jung at any minute. With two people's lives on the line, Dr. Kim needs to think fast.

Dr. Kim comes back unexpectedly, as they all thought he was still under investigation. Everyone doesn't also expect Dr. Kim's new visitor, who happens to be Chairman Shin himself. After being mocked by Hyeon Cheol for being incompetent, Dr. Kim now operates on the big boss. After Dong Joo speaks up of the truth of the unjust treatment received by Doldam Hospital, the chairman makes an important phone call.

Dong Joo tells Seo Jung to never leave without telling him again. Their conversation is interrupted by the 6-car accident on the road ahead of them. At the hospital, Eun Tak punches an investigator that prompts the need for police intervention. The problem faced by Dr. Kim now is the fact that the whole place is a mess, and there's chaos coming for them.

Seo Jung is caught inside Dr. Kim's office, while President Do convinces Dong Joo to be part of his team. Yoon Wan wants to test the worth of Dong Joo, while Dr. Kim worries that Seo Jung isn't trustworthy enough just yet. Dong Joo now deals with a patient who is suspected of being abused. The drunk driver from the major accident shows up with his rich mother that ultimately bothers Seo Jung.

An advanced death certificate needs to be signed by Dong Joo. He refuses to do so, but President Do and Hyeon Cheol urge him to act quickly against his will. Dr. Kim comes into the office just in time to witness the act. A cardiac arrest happens in the emergency ward, which prompts Dong Joo and Seo Jung to team up against the call of death. Another day in Doldam is another day of broken and mended hearts.

In Bum reveals the condition of Chairman Shin to Dr. Kim. His heart condition doesn't seem great, and he wants to assist in the operation. What appears to be a mere urge to take action is unknowingly a plot assembled by the president to keep an eye on Dr. Kim during his alleged unethical practice. An eager Seo Jung catches up on her mentor and gathers information to solve the medical case.

Dong Joo succumbs to the fatigue, and he ends up contracting the MERS virus. Although Dr. Kim wants to take over, Seo Jung stops him from risking his life for it. She enters and handles the deadly contagious patient. Now that she puts herself on the line, she also crosses herself out of the list of people allowed to operate on Chairman Shin the task she's worked hard on for the past weeks.

Seoyeong meets her dad for the first time in 3 years. But she's still as cold and unforgiving to him as ever. Meanwhile, Samjae gets depressed from the meeting and Seoyeong tries to begin her life over.

Ujae meets Samjae and Sangu and finally begins to understand... But the greatest thing he learns is that just because he forgives Seoyeong and understands her, it doesn't mean she'll find the love she once had for him again... Perhaps it's all too late now...

With all her memories restored, Yeonwoo meets Seol and asks about what truly happened the day she underwent the shamanic initiation rite. Meanwhile, Hwon orders Hong Gyu-tae to investigate in detail what occurred on the night the Crown Princess collapsed from her sudden illness.

Upon seeing Wol, Bogyeong panics, convinced that the supposedly dead Yeonwoo has returned. Although Yeonwoo comes face to face with Hwon, she chooses not to reveal her true identity. At the same time, Nokyoung discloses to Yeonwoo the name of an unexpected figure implicated in the incident from eight years ago.

With the mystery finally unraveled, Hwon rushes to the Bureau of Beneficence to find Yeonwoo—only for assassins to suddenly appear. In the chaos, Yangmyung grabs Yeonwoo's hand and flees with her. Meanwhile, having lost Yeonwoo once again, Yoon Daehyeong secretly orders assassins to eliminate Nokyoung.

Hwon learns from Hong Gyu-tae that Princess Minhwa was involved in the death of the Crown Princess. Meanwhile, Yeonwoo, who remains by Hwon's side, is tormented by her inability to offer him any comfort. Having reached a final decision, Hwon goes to confront the Grand Queen Dowager.

On her way to warn Hwon of an impending rebellion, Bogyeong witnesses him sharing a tender moment with Yeonwoo. Driven by jealousy and fear, Bogyeong summons Kwon, the former head shaman of Seongsucheong, and orders her to place a dark curse upon Yeonwoo.

programmes.d: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.
Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.
Winner of 2 Academy Awards, including Best Original Screenplay. With the help of his mentor, a slave-turned-bounty hunter sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner.
A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.
Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

The action and comedy never stop when Martin Lawrence and Will Smith reunite as out-of-control, trash-talking buddy cops. Bullets fly, cars crash, and laughs explode as they pursue a whacked-out drug lord from the streets of Miami to the barrios of Cuba.

When Mary and Lester's school teacher friend Mitchell meets Sandra, he sets out to win her pampered heart, no matter how many gifts or expensive dates it takes.
After a whirlwind courtship, Sandra accepts Mitchell's wedding proposal, making a commitment to trade in her glamorous life for what she not-so-long-ago considered a boring existence.
When Tom Willis makes opening his own business more important than his family and friends, he may get the business but lose everything else.
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

George riled by bare facts.

Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

After Andre compares Mary Jane's sexual aptitude to Avery's, Mary Jane responds by meeting a man online. And when Helen's diamond bracelet goes missing, both Paul Sr. and Helen expose their true feelings about their children.

Just when Mary Jane and Andre settle into living temporarily together, Mary Jane attends a charity gala and runs into an old love. Meanwhile at work, Mary Jane will be faced with a tough decision of protecting a friend.

Through the unbelievable stories of callers, a disc jockey and his guest therapist explore the struggles of relationships in L.A. In the process of listening to their stories, the disc jockey discovers his own issues about love.

A heart-broken young woman home for the holidays feels the family pressure to date again. Her sister sets up an online date with her dream man, a pro athlete. But things are not always as they seem, and true love may be closer to home.

Jason's ego takes a hit when Chardonnay rejects his proposal about hooking up after their upcoming annulment.

Linda's son Danny tries to plan his mom a surprise baby shower, but Philip has other plans to surprise Linda and asks her to marry him by singing and playing the piano.
Linda ask Ella Payne to help plan her wedding. Meanwhile, Curtis wants Floyd to pay him back for his investment in the diner.
Drew reveals her love for Danny.
Linda has to tell P.J. and Caroline that she's engaged to their father.
Linda meets Philip's ex in-laws; her family comes along.
Hattie prepares for spring cleaning at the diner; Linda explains why she can't move in with Phillip.
Linda threatens to call the wedding off if Philip does not change the furniture in his house.
Philip allows Linda to redecorate the house in whatever way she chooses.
After Hattie finds out that Danny got a promotion, she asks him to help pay for Linda's wedding.
Linda asks Hattie if she'll stay and help her when the baby comes, because she doubts that Philip will help with the newborn.
Danny shows Drew's cousin around for the weekend, and falls for her fast.
Troy and Danny inevitably do something stupid in Las Vegas. In the last minute, Linda's water breaks while she is 6 months pregnant.
Heartbroken, Linda has to put up with Danny's impulsive decisions.
Troy and Sam zero in on Danny.
Danny has to deal with how his friends and family feel about his wife.
Philip learns the basics of pregnancy.
When Nick makes a point that Suzanne is too controlling of the family, Suzanne backs off the issue and later the family realizes that her controlling ways are just what they need.
Nick, Suzanne, and Kevin pull pranks on each other, but their addiction leads to a near-death experience.
Gigi uses an adequate exercise when the family refuses to stop fighting with each other.
Suzanne's overprotective mother arrives and causes tension between her and Nick when she questions Nick's abilities as a husband.
A newly hired, attractive woman threatens Nick's job at the station.
When Marilyn brings a dangerous flu back from a trip to Mexico, the family must stay inside their house under quarantine.
Nick angers Suzanne when he invites Martin to an exclusive sporting event before inviting his wife.
Lindsey auditions to dance for a famous rapper's music video, but she later backs out after meeting with the powerful, demanding choreographer.
For Career Day, Nick serves as a guest speaker for Kevin's class, but his message ultimately confuses Kevin's classmates.
Nick and Suzanne's next door's neighbors become irresponsible house sitters.
Nick struggles to prove himself when he is promoted to co-host alongside the lazy, arrogant Brick Street.
Suzanne tries to keep Nick's birthday gift a surprise by taking out a loan from Marilyn.
Suzanne gathers everyone up for a family portrait.

programmes.d: Nick host a fund-raiser for charity. Elsewhere, Suzanne tangles with a wealthy client.

programmes.st: The Nick Gets an Assistant Episode
programmes.d: Nick is coerced into hiring an assistant, but the newbie gets too close to Nick's family and friends.
Nick and Suzanne get into an argument and refuse to talk to each other.
Lindsey and Kevin give to a charity, but Nick must step in when the charity keeps asking for more and more money.

Neek tries to brighten Charmaine's spirits after losing her father by arranging a surprise picnic for their fifth anniversary. Charmaine reveals some big news. Ryan, fresh out of therapy and feeling brand new, approaches leadership at 9MAG with new vigor.

programmes.st: Did You Make That Comment About Charmaine?
programmes.d: Attitudes fly, and feats of strength are tested when the members of 9MAG and 2nd City Ink attend a team bonding trip hosted by Ryan, who wants to rectify the last family dinner disaster. Meanwhile, not everyone wants to play on Charmaine's team.

An unexpected drug test has Tati freaking out. Sky announces a huge surprise. Quani makes a decision that shocks Puma. Rok airs out his dirty laundry - literally. And problems with the Brooklyn shop puts Ceaser on a collision course with the police.

Ceaser deals with the fallout of his arrest, and what it means for the Brooklyn shop. Alex and Donna try to get their mojo back in the bedroom. Bae confronts a shocking diagnosis. And Sky embarks on a new venture.

programmes.st: Nice Day For A Shotgun Wedding
programmes.d: Donna brings up people in Brooklyn talking trash about the upcoming Black Ink, which sets Ceaser off on a spiral through the past. Walt tries to make amends with Jessica. Sky embarks on a new business adventure. And Bae receives a welcome surprise.

After missing for a couple of weeks, Ted comes clean to Ceaser and Puma about why he's been so absent. Mike finally receives his long-awaited paternity test results. Jessica brings her son Xavier to meet Walt. Mike has a medical emergency.

The Brooklyn shop is finally open and Ceaser throws a block party to celebrate the grand opening. After Donna gives Alex an ultimatum, things don't go as expected. Crystal has a new jaw and a new attitude. Bae finds out Tati is hiding a big secret.

After opening the Brooklyn shop, rumors swirl about the altercation between Crystal and Miss Kitty. Sky struggles with the future of her Miami shop. News that Tati is dating a new man causes issues for Ted. Puma courts Rich for a return to the shop.

The crew heads to Cleveland for the first stop on Walt's comedy tour and to see Donna's hometown, but there are fireworks right off the bat. Alex finally meets Donna's dad and things don't go as planned.
Walt headlines his first comedy show tour in Cleveland. Kitty threatens to sue Ceaser while Alex tries to win Donna's dad over.

When Sky announces a Black Ink Prom, the competition for who will be King and Queen gets fierce. Q works with Crystal to get Ceaser back. One of Donna's tattoo clients sends a threatening letter to the shop.

programmes.st: The Problem With Torture Is Everybody Confesses
programmes.d: The crew is still reeling from the disastrous prom when Ceaser's most prized possession turns up missing. He launches an investigation into the potential thief which leads to some surprising decisions. Sky's son Des tries to track down his mom.

The news of Sky's suspension rocks the crew while Donna can't accept her apprentice demotion. Ceaser gets political and organizes a voter drive while Q faces a reckoning when his mom visits. Ceaser declares war on Ryan from 9MAG.

programmes.st: Dogs are More Loyal than Kits
programmes.d: Ceaser fumes over the video with Ryan and Kitty and plots revenge. Donna attempts to get her job back. Bae gets set up by a matchmaker and finds an unlikely bond with Rok. Walt and Jess' engagement party goes wheels off.
After a disastrous engagement party, Walt and Jess attend premarital counseling while the rest of the crew encourage Bae to face her biggest fear - confronting her abusive father.
Ceaser and the 113th crew travel to Philly for a tattoo convention and run into some frenemies. Jess has second thoughts about the wedding and Bae meets with her father one last time.

Ceaser fires his shot at Ryan and the two confront each other in a showdown. Relationship issues continue to worry Donna and Alex, while Walt has his own tale of woe. Ceaser receives news that could threaten the very existence of Black Ink New York.

When Eddie and Jamie become overly involved in a complicated adoption case between the birth and adoptive parents, they ask Erin to help them settle the dispute without going to court.
When Danny accepts a side job as a bodyguard for a recently released ex-con who took the fall for someone else, he uses the opportunity to go after the real criminal.
When diplomatic immunity complicates a child abuse case for Danny and Baez, Frank intervenes, despite not having jurisdiction on the case.
While investigating the murder of a gang leader, Danny and Baez learn the accused shooter is an ex-con who is romantically linked to his parole officer, who might be assisting in a cover up.

While investigating the murder of a man who killed a mother and son years earlier while driving drunk, Danny and Baez are torn between doing their job and finding justice after discovering the connection between the suspect and the victim.
When Linda's brother, Jimmy (Kevin Dillon), gets into trouble with the mob, he begs Danny to help him stay safe until it blows over.

Jamie and Eddie suspect foul play when they respond to a distress call from a woman having an allergic reaction to her lifesaving medication, and learn that her husband is an EMT assigned to take her call, but didn't respond.

Danny investigates the circumstances of an ex-NYPD officer who goes missing the day after she revealed to him that she had planned to make amends to the woman she and her partner wrongfully convicted years ago.

Erin faces off in court against her ex-husband, Jack (Peter Hermann), who is representing the person she is attempting to convict of murder. Also, Danny and Baez investigate to see if the husband is behind the murder of his wife.

After Reggie Wilson (Cyrus Farmer), a witness in a former case of Erin's, asks her for help shutting down a drug operation in his apartment building, she makes it her mission to make the building safe for his family.
Danny and Baez team up with two Russian operatives to search for a dangerous Russian man who entered the U.S. on a diplomatic visa.
When Danny intercepts a shipment of several million dollars that was heading to a drug cartel in Mexico, he becomes a target when they come back for revenge.

After a young girl goes missing, the family argues whether Danny used questionable methods in order to bring her home safely. Meanwhile, Jamie graduates from the police academy and begins his new life as a cop, on the series premiere.
A good Samaritan who takes action against a criminal terrorizing the subway has the Reagans pondering the rights and wrongs of vigilantism.
With a bomb set to detonate in Manhattan, Frank, Danny, and the rest of the NYPD search for its whereabouts. In the midst of the search, the Reagans argue the merits and downfalls of profiling.
Erin's family debates her methods when she uses a law-abiding citizen as bait to take down his gang leader brother.
Erin, Frank, and Danny work together within the system to find justice when a rape case's primary suspect is protected by diplomatic immunity.
A man who looks similar to Joe uses Joe's name and gets Joe in the position of facing the firing squad.
Joe is goaded into facing gunman Dan Taggert, unaware there is more to be prearranged than he realizes.
Hoss is seriously injured internally and Ben seeks help from the only doctor within 50 miles, who happens to be in prison for murder.
First Ben's sons are making lots of noise, so he goes into town to sleep in the hotel. Then, various noises and things interrupt Ben's sleep.  Will he ever get his desired good night's rest?
An author is inspired to write about the heroic Cartwrights after watching first-hand as they fight off an attempted robbery of a stage.
Mateo Ibara and his wife Carla visit the Ponderosa.  Ibara asks Will to return to Mexico with him. Ibara and Will fought together for Juarez's cause and Ibara saved Will's life.
A stranger, Bob Jolly, arrives in Virginia City to accuse a drunken Judge Harry Whitaker of sending his innocent father, Carl, to the gallows.

Dolly Bantree has a crooked manager ""Blackie"",  who blackmails Dolly to fleece newly rich miner Buford out of his newfound wealth. Hoss suspects something and gets all duded up to pose as a rich mark to test Dolly.
A vain outlaw murders a man in front of witnesses, including Joe, but a clever lawyer is able to get him acquitted.

programmes.st: A Pink Cloud Comes from Old Cathay
programmes.d: A headstrong Chinese girl (Marlo Thomas) visiting the Cartwrights incites labor unrest among local workers.
Adam's guitar-strumming friend, ranch hand Danny Morgan, is arrested on suspicion of murdering and robbing the Widow Baker.
The mother of a young outlaw condemned to hang, threatens to have her gang's hostages killed if her son is not set free.  One of the hostages is Joe.
Joe becomes romantically involved with a woman who considers herself a serious dramatic actress.  Unfortunately, she is the only one who does.
No one in Virginia City is happy to see ex-con Trace Cordell, especially the man he crippled in a gunfight, now married to Cordell's former girlfriend.
Frank Medford, a figure from Ben's "wild, misspent youth", shows up in Virginia City, and though down on his luck, creates troubles for the Cartwrights by claiming to be a successful businessman.
Hoss hires Waldo as a ranch hand after keeping Waldo from killing himself.  Hoss soon learns that Waldo is lousy at his job and only causes problems for everyone else due to his clumsiness.
Hoss is engaged to Carol Attley, a troubled woman with a past darker than he imagines.
Boruto realizes the magnitude of his father's love for the village and its people and, at the same time, his own weakness.
Sasuke and the Kage wage an intense battle against the ridiculously powerful Momoshiki and Kinshiki of the Otsutsuki Clan
With Boruto watching intently, Naruto and Sasuke begin their battle against a powered-up Momoshiki!
Boruto has made his rounds apologizing to everyone for his transgressions during the exam, but Momoshiki's prophecy continues to bother him.
Popular actors Tomaru and Ashina receive death threats from an unknown person, so Team 10 is assigned to a joint mission with Team 7 to guard them.
Tomaru's flirting has Cho-Cho on Cloud 9, but Sarada and the others worry that the lovestruck Cho-Cho has lost her focus on the mission!
The ninja in the gas mask appears again during filming and kidnaps Tomaru.
Metal's father, Rock Lee, announces that he will train Metal to master the ultimate taijutsu technique, the Eight Inner Gates.

programmes.st: The Hardest Rock in the World
programmes.d: The first Five Kage Summit since the attack by the Otsutsuki Clan is held in Hidden Leaf. The current Kage as well as their predecessors assemble, except the Third Tsuchikage, Ohnoki.
The ninja assigned to the Hidden Leaf Gate are attacked, and Mitsuki disappears.

programmes.st: The Other Side of the Moon
programmes.d: The village finds out that Boruto and Sarada have gone in search of Mitsuki, and Shikadai and his Team 10 are assigned a tracking mission to bring back them back.
Orochimaru tells Boruto and Sakura about the White Snake Sage who lives in Ryuchi Cave. On their way there, the two are confronted by Team 10.
Boruto and his friends are told they must pass a series of tests in order to meet the White Snake Sage!
The White Snake Sage tells Boruto to bring back the \"Reverse Scale\" from Garaga, a troublesome snake. Boruto and his friends head deeper into Ryuchi Cave and are confronted by a giant serpent.

programmes.st: A Fierce Enemy: Garaga's Ferocious Attack!
programmes.d: Boruto and the others work together to obtain the Reverse Scale from Garaga. But the battle proves difficult, as Garaga has the power to sense the location of its enemies and turn them into stone.
Mitsuki heads toward Kokuyou and Sekiei's homeland, the Land of Earth.
Boruto and his friends manage to overcome Kokuyou, and finally catch with up Mitsuki.
Instead of returning home with Boruto, Mitsuki stays with Kokuyou.
Boruto is injured, unconscious and unable to continue. Everyone thinks about returning to the Hidden Leaf.
The team secretly enters the village determined to find Ohnoki, but they are unaware that they are being watched.
The team finds Ohnoki, but he flatly refuses to help. On top of which, they are attacked and separated.
Boruto and Ohnoki head to the rendezvous point, but they stumble into the Hidden Stone Shinobi Training Grounds
In order to get out of the barrier, Boruto desperately searches for his heart of stone, but he has little success.
Ohnoki takes Boruto to a special location to explain his vision of the future, formed after losing his grandchild, Kozuchi.
Kakou uses a rare and powerful Particle Style and pushes Boruto to the edge.
Boruto and Sarada are caught and taken back to the Hidden Stone headquarters along with Ohnoki.
Kirara appears and turns Boruto and Sarada into "dolls" that must obey her, ordering the two to kill each other.
Shocked and confused by the actions of Mitsuki, Sekiei recklessly attacks him.
Ku appears once again to provoke and attack Boruto.
Boruto and the other Leaf Genin return to the Hidden Leaf with Mitsuki
Boruto and his sister Himawari await Family Day with anticipation.

programmes.st: A Heaping Helping! The Eating Contest!
programmes.d: Boruto comes across an eating contest, held by the popular eateries in the Leaf for Parent and Child Day.

programmes.st: Tactics for Getting Along With Your Daughter
programmes.d: Boruto runs into his teacher Sasuke, who�s returned to the village after a long absence.

The 14 horrible cooks start off by making their favorite homemade dishes.
The recruits are challenged to pair fruit and meat in farm-to-table dishes.
After learning about sauces, the recruits have to make saucy enchiladas.
The recruits learn about flavor pairings and create their own roulades.
It's sink or swim as the recruits make mussels and seafood risotto.
The recruits are challenged to decorate cupcakes and make fresh pasta.
The recruits try to get into the finale with their family-style dishes.
The judges sample the recruits' final dishes and award the $25,000 prize.

programmes.st: Best of the Worst: Ready for Redemption
programmes.d: Anne and Michael test the recruits to see who has improved and who has not.
The Cabin Masters create a main bedroom for a cabin built in just 72 hours.
The crew works to transform a lobster shack into a vibrant living space.
Chase and his team convert a gambrel garage into a functional living space.
A rivalry divides the team as they tackle a 1906 cabin in eight weeks.

programmes.st: A Cabin Tribute to Mimi Eva
programmes.d: The crew restores a cabin for Chase's wife as a tribute to her late mother.
The team refurbishes a property for a family of longtime Maine residents.
Chase and the team give a family's 1970s cottage a fresh update.
The team converts the first post office in Manchester, Maine, into a cabin.
The team honors a local grandfather by continuing renovations on his cabin.
The team takes on a cabin that was renovated by Chase and Ashley's father.
The Cabin Masters update a family's 30-year-old cabin in time for summer.
The team rescues a cabin that's sinking due to a stream running under it.
The team tackles a rotted out cabin and bunkhouse on Cook's Beach.
The team tackles a 1960s cabin and must stay within the original footprint.
The crew is challenged to turn a shipping container into a family's cabin.
The team battles harsh weather to restore a medieval roleplaying community.

programmes.st: A Blank Slate Build for Mom
programmes.d: The team designs and builds an original cabin for a family's matriarch.
A family cries for help expanding their camp and letting in the light.
A family hopes to rebuild better after a storm destroys their camp.
A man honors his dad's memory while building space for his family and pets.
The YMCA Camp of Maine wants more bathrooms, a chicken coop and more.

When bigoted ex-con Earl Slater agrees to carry out a heist with a disgraced former cop and his cohorts – one of whom is Black – tensions mount as the job comes together, until Earl’s seething hatred erupts, risking the heist...and their lives!
Set in Paris' famous Red Light district, a rookie policeman (Jack Lemmon) plots to keep a beautiful prostitute (Shirley MacLaine) all to himself in this hit comedy from director Billy Wilder.

Ram (Paul Newman) and Eddie (Sidney Poitier) are two expatriate jazz musicians living in Paris, where their music is celebrated. When they fall in love with two vacationing American girls, they must decide if they should move back to America with them.

A waning director revives his career after discovering a beautiful Spanish dancer and makes her into a Hollywood star. Ava Gardner, Humphrey Bogart and Edmond O’Brien star in this bitter tale of stardom won and wasted from Joseph L. Mankiewicz.
A famous cat burglar who has retired to the Riviera catches a thief imitating his old style.
Romance and suspense ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. Whom can she trust?
Audrey Hepburn's portrayal of a modern-day princess, rebelling against the royal obligations, who explores Rome on her own. This romantic comedy ranks as one of the most enjoyable films of all times.

Bogie and Holden are the mega-rich Larrabee brothers of Long Island. Bogie’s all work, Holden’s all playboy. But when Sabrina (Hepburn), daughter of the family’s chauffeur, returns from Paris, the stage is set for some family fireworks.
Felix turns to Oscar for help after complaining he no longer can communicate with his daughter.
Rob recounts the wrath he encountered when he broke his engagement with his hometown sweetheart, Dorothy after he and Laura became engaged.
Rob finds himself in hot water after giving a television interview in which he unwittingly portrays his wife Laura as a nut.

programmes.st: I Was a Teenage Head Writer
programmes.d: Rob leaves the show after Mel rejects his script and is upset when Buddy and Sally don't join him.

programmes.st: It May Look Like a Walnut
programmes.d: Rob and Laura watch a scary movie only to find certain details of that movie coming true the following day.
Laura tries to break Rob of his expensive habit of picking up the check.
To his regret, Rob ignores Laura's warning to be careful on the slopes during his first skiing excursion.
The Petries hire a painter who ends up painting much more than just their living room.
Rob, Laura, and the office gang put together a variety show to help out an old friend.
Rob plans to make himself scarce when he hears French heartthrob and old acquaintance, Jacques Savon, is Alan's guest star.
Rob finds himself very out of place at a dinner party for celebrated literati.
Kate uses her charms to keep Homer Bedloe from catching the train to Pixley.

programmes.st: The President Who Came To Dinner
programmes.d: President of the railroad comes to visit the Shady Rest hotel with the intention to terminate the Cannonball's service.

programmes.st: Is There A Doctor In The Roundhouse
programmes.d: Norman Curtis breaks the Cannonball's throttle lever, threatening the success of the Shady Rest Hotel's annual jamboree.
Kate's intentions are mistaken when she tries to help Floyd Smoot regain his confience after being slighted by the woman he loves.
Kate is forced to peddle cologne when Uncle Joe buys a bunch of cases with the money meant for window screens.
Betty Jo must challenge the legendary Pixley Fats in the Annual Horeshoe Tournament.
Kate tries to teach Betty Jo how to make Hot Rhubarb after setting her up on a double date.
Bank robbers stay the night at Shady Rest hoping to intercept a bank shipment on the Cannonball.
Uncle Joe is pelted with eggs after his team, the Hooterville Hornets lose a game.
Kate hires Herby to work as an Assistant Manager at the hotel, causing Uncle Joe to fear for his position.
It's Survival Training for the platoon: two-man teams must rough it for five days. Thinking Gomer will bring down the platoon's rating, Sgt. Carter takes him for his partner.
Gomer and his fellow Marines are headed into town on day passes when one of them is stuck on guard duty.

programmes.st: The Case of the Marine Bandit
programmes.d: While hitching a ride to town Gomer stops to help a stranded motorist, she takes him into town to meet her mother. A robber is holding up liquor stores while wearing a Marine's uniform at the same time.
A mix-up leads Carter to believe Gomer's dying.
Gomer's conned into signing a contract for dancing lessons.

programmes.st: Sergeant Carter Gets a 'Dear John' Letter
programmes.d: Carter asks Gomer to take his place on a date.
Carter's adopted Korean daughter arrives, but she's not the little girl he remembers.
Carter tries for the Officer Candidate School.
Gomer tries to collect money for Carter's birthday.
Carter may have to use Gomer as an honor guard since he owns a blue dress uniform.

Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.
The roommate of a slain police officer agrees to be bait in a rape investigation. After Mike Stone kicks her off the case, she continues on her own, hurtling headlong into peril.
Mannix investigates why his cop friend, who served time for a crime he did not commit, killed his former cellmate and fled with $150,000 in stolen money.
Tough L.A. police Lt. Ira Deegan is warned off the investigation of a heist that netted $85,000 -- a threat that seems to have come true when his garage is blown up, although no one is hurt.
A married couple is scared into silence by a gangster who they saw run down his girlfriend, but their young boy tries to hire Mannix for help.
Joe Mannix is hired by a secretive businessman named Alton K. Moore, who wants Mannix to look for his son Cal, a college basketball player who has been missing for several days.
Mannix investigates death threats against a young woman that had a car accident that killed her pregnant friend and left her legs paralyzed.

programmes.st: Blood Money Is Hard to Wash
programmes.d: Mainland gangster Victor Jovanko terrorizes football team owner to sell club for money laundering operation for mainland syndicate.
McGarrett investigates mystery of sunken Soviet sub, becomes suspicious when computer storage unit needed to unlock secrets appears.

programmes.st: Requiem for a Saddle Bronc Rider
programmes.d: Why have the bodies of a young man, painted bright orange, and a young woman been dumped into the sea? Five-O Chief Steve McGarrett has no knowledge, yet, of that incident, but his search for a missing rodeo cowboy is related.
The runaway teenager daughter of legendary Los Angeles police detective Babe Mandell is framed for murder, then frantically   vanishes   into a religious cult to escape pursuers.

A grim team of crooks who are out to steal M-16 rifles from military armories and sell them to inter-national terrorists, plus a pair of hang-gliding pranksters add up to double trouble for McGarrett.
An Irish Terrorist engineers a hijacking from a U.S. military facility of a load of exotic new explosives for the purpose of smuggling it to northern Ireland.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Cyrus Chambers and Tom Dalton are business partners in town, but when Cyrus decides he wants out of the partnership the trouble starts. Money and a secret love affair drive Tom to stop at nothing to bring Cyrus down, not even murder.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Wilson Sweet is curious about the murder of his grandfather over forty years ago and finds the incident may not have happened like he was told. An old bluesman in town has written a song about the murder and brings light to what really happened.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: For Bubba Skinner and his date Mary Ellen, a picnic ends in gunshots and the discovery of a large marijuana operation. When the wrong bullet slug is found on the ballistics report, Gillespie and Tibbs suspect that a Sheriff’s Deputy may be involved.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: District Attorney Gerard Darnelle is tough on criminals and has made many enemies throughout his long career. When his daughter is kidnapped, the FBI arrives, but Gillespie and Tibbs sidestep them and follow their own leads to bring her home safely.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: When Lonnie Jamison helps Francie Miller, an old high school crush who’s in deep trouble and hitting the bottle, he finds a connection between Francie’s low-life boyfriend, Nick Crews, and a recent armed robbery of a local Sparta supermarket.
Journalist Ellen Sharp is meeting Phil Gwynn at a nightclub; apparently, he has a big scoop for her.
While Amanda Bentley visits Martin, a good friend, and benefactor of a visiting Communist Chinese dance troupe, Tako, the star dancer drops dead.
Special Olympian athletes are in town for the competition. One girl makes friends with the Rangers and their friends. She witnesses a hitman's attack on Trent to prevent him from testifying in court.

A high school principal reaches out to Walker when his school is overrun by drugs. It appears to be an inside job as the students always know when there is a raid. When the principal finds the leader, he is killed.

The Cherokee Indian racing team is experiencing a lot of problems with their cars and drivers. A rival team wants to make sure the Cherokee does not win the races. Meanwhile, a young girl is kidnapped so Trent and Carlos search for her.
A Cherokee driver is injured by a rival racing team. Walker takes his place in the race.

Models are being kidnapped to be sold in a sex-slavery auction. Trivette's girlfriend is the most recent disappearance. The Rangers must find where the models are being held before the sale is finished.
While visiting his hometown, MacGyver is forced to recall a painful incident from his past when he comes to the aid of a young boy involved in a shooting.
MacGyver is forced to settle a dispute between the Amish and some land developers after an accident threatens the lives of two children.

programmes.st: On A Wing And A Prayer
programmes.d: MacGyver and Jack Dalton, posing as arms dealers, infiltrate a Latin American rebel camp where a wounded Pete Thornton is being held hostage.
MacGyver finds himself behind the wheel of an experimental race car after his buddy is injured In a mysterious crash during the qualifying heats.
High-power and high-profile defense attorney, Roger Calendar, is brought into the emergency room with a near-fatal stabbing wound.
As Lt. Steve Sloan and his partner, Cheryl, pick up their favorite strawberry milkshakes, Steve is distracted by a beautiful woman.
Calvin Laird, Mark and Steve's neighbor, threatens his girlfriend violently when she challenges his mean behavior. His repeated playing of loud music bothers the Sloans to no end.
A film school buddy of Alex's is at Community General Hospital making a documentary about the legend of a ghost in the basement.
When a hit-and-run patient mysteriously dies in the hospital, Dr. Sloan and his interns, Jack and Amanda, put their amateur crime solving abilities to the test.
A mobster's gun moll fakes her way past hospital security guards, and Dr. Sloan almost becomes her next victim! Attractive and smart, no one suspected Amy Westin's true identity.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Bud, the Caretaker
programmes.d: Margaret wins a car in a raffle and uses it to help out an orphanage.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Great Experiment
programmes.d: Things don't exactly work out as planned when Jim attempts to get family members to expand their horizons.

Cissy falls for a popular musician who writes songs about her. When he leaves for his next tour date, love-struck Cissy decides to surprise him by going to the concert. She is the one surprised when he starts singing to another woman.
Mr. French is accused of sending questionable letters to a young woman. He and Bill take a stint as a detective to find the source.
Cissy meets some flower children in the park and wants to be one of them. Uncle Bill is none too pleased.

Movie producer Fred Wallace spots Mr. French in the park and thinks he would be perfect to play Henry VIII in his new production. The very proper French flatly declines. After some convincing by his friends and family, he agrees to do it.

Mr. French, Cissy, Buffy, and Jody decide to give Bill some time alone for the weekend. Unfortunately, while they are away, a barrage of neighbors stops by, disrupting Bill's relaxation, peace, and quiet.

A former friend of Bill's visits, asking for a favor. Harv has just gotten out of prison and needs to find a job. The twins are afraid of Harv, and Cissy thinks she can help him adjust to living outside of prison again.
One of Cissy's friends has a crush on Uncle Bill, and he cannot shake her from this feeling.

Cissy decides it is time to move out on her own, so she moves into an apartment with a friend. It seems like she hasn't left home when her family constantly visits her. She tells them to let her enjoy her own place by herself.
Maude's investigation into Vivian's erratic behavior reveals a new part of the Harmon's marriage and almost all of Vivian.
Maude's Aunt Lola, who is irresistible to married men -- and vice versa -- zeros in on Mrs. Naugatuck's husband, Bert, as her next conquest.

Arthur's seemingly sudden devotion to a new best friend leaves Walter hurt, angry, and determined to make a new friend of his own. Maude lends a sympathetic ear, but it doesn't help Walter, who feels he has lost his only true friend.
Vivian's pleasure at Arthur's sudden burst of amorous behavior is overcome by panic when it becomes obvious that Arthur is just not himself.

Maude's anger over Mrs. Naugatuck's sudden strange behavior threatens to end their three-year friendship. Maude fires Mrs. Naugatuck, and insists that she leave immediately, until she finds out that she will never see Mrs. Naugatuck again.

Maude is furious when she discovers her wallet is missing after an encounter with a West Indian woman in a New York subway. Her fury turns to rage when the woman suddenly shows up at the Findlay house.
Driven by a severe case of guilt, Maude extends a less than sincere invitation to her trying aunt Tinkie, but can't possibly be prepared for the suffering yet to come.
Maude's liberal beliefs are put to test when she insists that Phillip invite his friend Sam to spend the night, only to be confronted by an unexpected situation.
A UFO has been sighted over Tuckahoe, but no one believes it because it's Maude who's spotted it.
The liberated woman has no place in society...at least that is what Victoria Butterfield's father professes and Maude protests.

Gloria has been reading books on women's lib and encourages Edith to try a little liberation. However, Mike won't take any of her ideas, which leads to huge fight in which Gloria demands that Mike recognize her as an equal partner in their marriage.

Archie is all set to go to the Mets game; however, Edith has different plans after she accepted an invitation to dinner with the Jeffersons. Archie discovers this and comes up with the excuse that Edith sprained her ankle, thus turns down the invitation.

Mike's artist friend, Szabo, is coming to the Bunker's house. Archie is a bit perplexed for two reasons. First, he is Hungarian. The other is that he sketches models in the nude. Szabo gets a great idea that Gloria should pose in the nude for him.

Archie is furious with his houseguest, Cousin Oscar. When they were kids, Oscar bullied Archie and now Oscar is taking full advantage of his visit at the Bunkers. Archie wants to throw him out, but Oscar makes an exit of his own when he turns up dead.

Mike and Gloria are all excited about their first wedding anniversary and order take-out as a special dinner. Sitting around the dinner table, an argument ensues which leads to Edith recalling the day Archie met Mike.

The family manages to collect $30 in the family pot and an argument ensues when Edith wants to use the money to set her lyrics for a song to music. Meanwhile, Archie is disturbed by robberies in the neighborhood and wants to use the money to buy a gun.

Mike and Lionel are planning on attending a demonstration at the United Nations. However, the rally gets out of hand and news of it appears on TV. This worries Gloria who begs Archie to go down there and get Mike.

A local election has the Bunker family in turmoil as Mike and Gloria are all for Claire Packer, a woman, which is why Archie is dead set against her. However, once down at the voting booths, Archie realizes that he can't vote because he isn't registered.

At the grocery store, Edith has an accident in the parking lot. She loses control of her shopping cart which smashes into a car and a can of Cling Peaches (in heavy syrup) flies out of the cart, onto the car, and makes a dent.

Mike is all stressed out with upcoming exams leaving him impotent and frustrated. Gloria encourages him to discuss it with her, but he refuses. Gloria confides in Edith what the problem is, and in turn she tells Archie.
Ellen announces that she was named Raytown's Woman of the Year. At the Banquet, Ellen is having a delightful time, until her family arrives and embarrasses her at the Country Club.
Naomi isn't feeling well, leading Mama to think she is pregnant. The family starts fighting because none of them want to give up their rooms for a new baby.
Naomi, Ellen, and Eunice are in a panic at the hospital because Mama has had an accident. Vint comes and asks what has happened, but each of the women has their own tale about how it happened.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

programmes.t: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
programmes.d: Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as "The Lord of the Rings," "Game of Thrones," "The Chronicles of Narnia" and "Harry Potter." Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.

programmes.t: The LSO performs Dvořák and Tchaikovsky
programmes.d: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.
Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem.

In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo; Norwegian conductor Eivind Gullberg Jensen leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the National Opera Oslo.

programmes.t: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programmes.d: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programmes.st: Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programmes.d: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.

Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz's "Symphonie," Op. 14; this performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programmes.t: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programmes.d: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance recorded at St Luke's in London on May 18th, 2022; the program consists of a variety of works: D'un Matin de Printemps by Lili Boulanger.
The murder of an Ohio woman in 1974 is solved more than 20 years later after police get a crucial clue--the woman's husband was seen building a coffin-shaped box about the time the woman disappeared.
A Texas woman's murder is finally solved when the killer's plan to kill a second woman and stuff her into a duffel bag goes awry.
A bloody dagger and a phone tap help detectives solve a 20-year-old murder case. And DNA taken from an eyelash found on a dead prostitute's body brings a killer to justice.
The case of a gruesome stabbing death of a bullied teenager remains unsolved for 27 years.

After U.S. Navy sailor disappears in 68, the Navy claims he went AWOL. But his sister works for over 30 years to prove that he was really killed. And DNA from a cigarette butt helps detectives to unravel a 20-year-old case of rape and murder.

On a summer night in 1987, a 17-year-old girl to come home is found raped and strangled near the Hudson River. And In 1983, a young mother is raped and murdered at work. The crime remains unsolved for two decades.

While hiking with husband Dennis in Montana, Leslee Larson fell into Wolf Creek. Then Dennis is convicted of murdering his wife, while in Main. And 15-year-old papergirl Penny Parker goes missing, then her body is found by a search volunteer.

A videotape made at an ATM machine helps police in Louisville, KY, to nab a man suspected of raping 13 women. And a DA investigator in Georgia helps crack a murder case that his father, a police chief, first worked on 30 years before.

In 1979 Janie Landers disappears from a home for the impaired--the latest consequence of the facility's history of neglect. When Janie's body is found, there are many suspects but it is years before the killer is found.
Police solve a murder when divers find a skeleton in a car at the bottom of a river, and a dead dog's DNA helps crack open a 6-year-old case.

Work of an Alberta, Canada detective finally pays off when he tracks down the man who murdered a 6-year-old girl 10 years earlier. And when police search for the killer of a hitchhiker, they find that the victim's diary is one of their best clues.
The longest-running cold case of a law enforcement officer in the United States was the murder of Sheriff's Lt. Joe Clark.

On February 2, 2010, two masked gunmen commit a violent robbery and shoot Michael Temple Jr., rendering him a quadriplegic for five years before his death. In this unusual cold case, DNA is used to create a sketch of the killer.

A police investigator discovers a letter written 16 years earlier that provides clues to a woman's murder. And a firearms expert supplies the evidence that South Carolina authorities need to put a man on trial in 2002 for a murder committed in 1961.
A mother is suspected in the murders of two of her daughters when her third daughter finally convinces police to reopen two cold cases.

With access to the San Francisco Police Department's work, including saliva samples taken from letters the infamous Zodiac Killer sent 30 years ago, we reevaluate the case of the serial killer who began terrorizing California in the late 1960s.

programmes.st: Gone in a New York Minute
programmes.d: In a city of eight million, landlord Bruce Blackwood disappears without a trace in March 2006. Though there is no body, the NYPD is sure this is a homicide and they spend the next nine years searching for answers.

programmes.st: Tiffany Haddish, Desus & Mero & Jimmy Kimmel
programmes.d: A woman hatches a scheme to get space from a coworker, Elmer wants his late wife's obituary to help him find love, and a cornhole enthusiast explains how the game has changed his life.

programmes.st: Adam Carolla, Kathy Griffin & Kyle Dunnigan
programmes.d: A concerned Sunday school teacher calls a bookstore to help them find salvation, Craig looks for professionals to keep him safe from his mother, and a woman wants a lesbian-friendly bird.
Nathan places a controversial ad in a pet cemetery, takes tips from a focus group in order to become more likable and devises a method to clean a house in six minutes flat.
Nathan comes up with a way to sell alcohol to minors, helps an exterminator land a hotel contract and uses birds to draw customers to a car wash.
Nathan makes use of parody law to open up a coffee shop nearly identical to Starbucks in its branding and appearance.
Nathan comes up with a way to get a failing taxi company some much-needed press and implements a risky new line-cutting policy at a hot dog stand.
Nathan markets an unappealing children's toy, devises a way to shame people who share their movie snacks and pitches a reality show starring Simon the security guard.
Nathan tries to leverage Best Buy's price-matching policy by advertising a deal on TVs that's too good to be true.
Nathan devises a way to provide a moving company with free labor.
Nathan recruits child athletes for endorsement deals and finds a way to put drunk people's clumsiness to good use.
Nathan works with the owner of a bar to turn her business into an immersive theater experience.
Nathan makes it easier for parents to have sex in a hotel room and finds a way for a travel agent to better serve her aging customers.
Episode 9 includes Walkathon, Temporary Insanity, Tainted Meat, Dream On, and Beaverly Buttbillies, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.

Beavis & Butthead features two lunkheaded teenagers who dress in heavy-metal T-shirts, love stuff that is "cool," hate stuff that "sucks," and spend most of their time sitting on a couch making fun of music videos.
Episode 10 includes Babysitting, Buttniks, and Bungholio: Lord of the Harvest.
Episode 2 includes Party, What's the Deal, Wet Behind the Rears, and Animation Sucks.
Episode 3 includes Candy Sale, Here Comes the Bride's Butt, Pregnant Pause, and Oil Change.
Clemmy scandalizes Kimball's Christian singles karaoke club, and Dangle takes bets on the origins of Wiegel's baby.
The deputies vow to avenge Sheriff Chechekevitch's death, and Wiegel studies with Lamaze instructor Guy Gerricault.
The Reno Sheriff's Department inherits a beautiful, cursed jet ski from a fallen deputy.
Hotty's Restaurants sponsors the Reno Sheriff's Department, and the gang gets burned by the deal.
Rick the Citizens' Patrolman one-ups the Sheriff's Department in investigating a crime spree, and Garcia receives a visit from an old, unpredictable friend.
Jones and Garcia discover that not just anyone can dispense justice from horseback.
Dangle visits his ex-wife and her new husband on their anniversary, and the lady deputies stake out a lecherous meth dealer and his girlfriends.
The Reno Sheriff's Department takes more than seven hours to respond to a liquor store robbery.
When the citizens of South Park start exploding randomly, the mayor enlists Stan's dad, the resident geologist, to find a solution to the problem.
Chef's parents arrive in South Park from Scotland fresh from an encounter with the Loch Ness Monster to attend Chef's wedding.
The boys discover a prehistoric creature called a Jackovasaur while camping at Stark's Pond.
After Sexual Harassment Panda 'educates' the children, Cartman sues Stan for sexual harassment, and a flurry of other lawsuits follow.
While all the adults are gathering at Mr. Mackey's house to watch a meteor shower Shelly Marsh is left babysit Cartman.
Kyle invites Kenny to join him and Ike at Jewbilee, a camp for Jewish kids.
Korn comes to South Park for a Halloween concert and helps the boys solve a spooky pirate ghost mystery.

A Florida socialite is swept up into a twisted tale of money and murder.
Teen sisters mysteriously disappear after leaving for the movies in 1965.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With the field narrowed down to 119 women, the pressure is on.  They must quickly learn a power pom routine and the famous kickline in order to perform it an hour later before the judges.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The veterans finally enter the audition process. Now all 83 women are judged head to head during a panel interview, a solo dance performance and on their appearance on the football field as seen and the big screen.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: First, the ladies need to have the "classic look" of a Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader.  Kelli's hair and make-up transformations are legendary.  The ladies are also assessed through a new state of the art fitness test, "Styku".

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kelli media trains the rookie candidates to determine who best represents the DCC at press events.  NBC news anchor, Meredith Land tests their on-camera interview skills.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Personality is critical when representing the DCC brand.  Kelli takes the women on location to see how they interact during a public appearance.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Katy Perry's choreographer, Nick Florez, stops by to offer some performance advice to the ladies.  A day that each cheerleader never forgets.  The first time they wear the DCC uniform to pose for their cameo photos.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The squad goes on an appearance to support pop music star, Demi Lovato. The ladies learn the entrance to the famed pre-game dance.  It's a make or break moment.  If a woman can't learn it quickly it might be her last night.

When Dr. Sloan's wealthy womanizing patient, Robert Stroud, mysteriously disappears, Sloan uncovers a greedy plot hatched by the women in Stroud's life. It's a murderous plan ripe with blackmail and betrayal--and a shockingly twisted conclusion!
Now you see it, now you don't. A despised lawyer turns up murdered at Community General and before the police can arrive, the body mysteriously disappears.
It's a tasty tale for the t.v. tabloids when Community General's most famous patient attractive t.v. star, Pamela, is caught on tape fleeing the murder scene of ex-husband number four.

It's a strange twist of fate when millionaire William Bissell, checks into the hospital and stumbles upon his ex-lover, Nurse Jenny Morgan. After Bissell's found murdered by lethal injection, Jenny becomes the number one suspect.
As a favor to a colleague, Dr. Sloan agrees to perform surgery on mafia kingpin Alfred Johnson. A supposed routine heart operation turns into an untimely death for The Don.

Dying of gunshot wounds, private investigator Charlie Harper whispers one final cryptic message to Dr. Sloan. Intrigued, Sloan searches for the meaning of the dying man's last words with the aid of Charlie's secretary, Georgia.

Selected by Bravo Magazine as one of L.A.'s most eligible bachelors, Dr. Jack Stewart isn't aware the honor is dangerous to his health.
Amidst the corridors of Community General Hospital, the hit t.v. show The New Healers is shooting their next episode.
Refusing to believe that a long-time patient, Alex Forman, committed suicide, Dr. Sloan launches his own investigation.

What could be more dangerous than a psychopathic killer with a taste for revenge! Eddie Gault, recently paroled, has only one thing on his mind--making Lt. Steve Sloan suffer for putting him in prison.
Searching for a new way to promote Community General, Norman Briggs decides to have the hospital sponsor a women's professional volleyball team.
It's not just another day at the beach when an investigative reporter out for her daily swim drowns. The lifeguard, Rip, is blamed for the death despite his protests of innocence.
A night school class in law draws Lieutenant Steve Sloan into another police investigation.

Cesar helps actress Rhona Mitra curb her bulldog's violent tendencies; a newly-wed couple's Chihuahua assumes dominance over their sheltie mix.
A widow's retriever mix and two fox terriers do not get along; a Shar-Pei/Doberman mix drools excessively on car rides; Cesar revisits a Rottweiler mix.
After a 45-day stint in Iraq and two hurricanes, an explosive-sniffing ATF Labrador retriever begins exhibiting severe symptoms of terror.
Cesar Millan helps an overly aggressive German shepherd and a timid rat terrier.

A Yorkshire terrier who became aggressive after going blind; a spoiled Pekingese/miniature poodle mix; a Rottweiler with a dangerous obsession with the horses on the ranch where she lives.
