According to physics, time travel is possible. So could it be that UAPs aren't coming from somewhere else, but from some when else. Could these UAPs be us, from the future?
In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight?
It is likely that aliens exist in a universe as large as ours. How would they navigate those vast distances and potentially visit us on earth?

The Dobhar Chu (pronounced do-war coo), is a mythical monster that has inhabited the lakes of the British Isles since ancient times. The name, roughly translated means water hound, or hound of the deep. Thought to be a cross between a giant otter and …

Since 1735, legend has it that a demonic creature, the Jersey Devil, has stalked the woods of one of America’s oldest states. Famous for its beaches, mosquitoes and Atlantic City casinos, New Jersey is also home to a monster.

A monster has terrorized the Belize countryside for centuries. It is described as looking like a small man, three-feet tall, with an ugly face, hands without thumbs and inverted feet, said to make it harder to track. According to legend, it wears a r …
The Bridgewater Triangle is a hub of UFO sightings, alien abductions, and encounters with the mysterious Dover Demon and the troll-like Pukwudgie.
Explore Appalachia's eerie forests, where locals recount encounters with the terrifying Sheepsquatch, the winged Mothman, and alien visitors.

programmes.st: Melonheads, Devil Monkey, Blue Albino Woman
programmes.d: Across America, grotesque mutant monsters like Melonheads, Devil Monkey, and the Blue Albino Woman seek revenge, terrorizing their victims with horrifying attacks.
For decades, citizen UFOlogists have coordinated alien information-sharing networks, subverting the classified intelligence of their governments.
A mysterious photograph with no plausible explanation. An aborted nuclear launch half a world away. And the continuing appearance of mysterious men in black.
Examining the possibility that UFOs may be from Earth.
Humanity has been plagued by international conflicts and epic powers since the dawn of time. Perhaps our greatest failure is constant strife and division.
Since the Jet Age, fighter pilots have been scrambled to intercept UFOs in our skies, but what happens when pilots are sent a Shoot Down Order and can't complete their mission?
Aliens have been trying to make contact with mankind for millennia. Now for the first time, one of those messages has been decoded and we will share that message with the world.

Ed and Beth's ranch house seems like the perfect place to raise their toddler‚ until they discover that they are not alone and a dark heavy mist that hangs over the house‚ and grows larger, day-by-day

Jay Yaple persuades his wife that Enfield, CT, is the perfect place for them. After a series of unexplained events, Jay discovers the house has a dark history of mysterious deaths. Anyone who attempts to come to their aid is driven away by the demon.

The Fox family moves into a large old house in Lowell, Arkansas. Soon after, an angry ghost and demon begin to target the children, in their waking hours and in their dreams. The Fox family turns to a psychic, who confirms their worst nightmares.

Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.
A woman (Rachel Weisz) returns to her Orthodox Jewish community after the death of her rabbi father and stirs up controversy when she shows an interest in an old childhood friend (Rachel McAdams).

In 2028, Los Angeles is in the midst of the most violent riot in its history. Four bank robbers botch a heist and head to the Hotel Artemis, a penthouse and an ER that exclusively serves criminals – all of whom now set their sights on the robbers.
This romantic comedy centers on the chaotic love life of Jeffrey, a gay man who swears off sex only to fall in love with his ideal man.

Good girl Mary (Jena Malone) can't believe it when she gets pregnant by her newly-gay boyfriend. She also can't believe the actions of her popular, relentlessly devout best friend, Hilary Faye (Mandy Moore).

programmes.t: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
programmes.d: For three showgirls it was the dream of a lifetime, a four week cabaret engagement in Alice Springs. The problem is simply getting there intact, along with their bus Priscilla. It's not easy being a drag queen in the outback!

Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx (Mia Goth) finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

Seduction, passion and power struggles unfold as the creators of Basic Instinct blow the lid off the seemingly glamorous world of Las Vegas showdancing in this controversial film that stars Elizabeth Berkley.

Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born.  But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

Born in the flames of hell and brought to Earth, Hellboy was rescued from sinister forces by the benevolent Dr. Broom, who raised him to be a hero. Hellboy stands as the key line of defense against an evil madman who seeks to destroy mankind.
When the enormous monster descends upon New York, it's up to the Army and an odd team of investigators to unravel the mystery behind the incredible creature before it's too late.

Bruce Willis, Milla Jovovich, and Gary Oldman star in acclaimed director Luc Besson's outrageous sci-fi adventure, an extravagantly styled tale of good against evil set in an unbelievable twenty-third-century world.
A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

One of nature's most perfect killing machines has been re-engineered as something smarter, faster, and deadlier. When things go wrong, the aquatic killing machines begin hunting their creators, who are alone and adrift on the Deep Blue Sea.

On a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes, leaving two astronauts completely alone. As the deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth, the only way home may be to go further into the terrifying expanse of space.
Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz star in this nonstop action epic about the discovery of a long-lost treasure in the Egyptian desert that also unearths a 3,000-year-old legacy of terror!

Mark invites Alma to be his red carpet date for the Boston premiere of "Patriot's Day." Meanwhile, Paul visits the Las Vegas Wahlburgers where new neighbor and country music legend John Rich proposes a delicious business partnership.

Donnie's trip to the grand opening of the second Orlando Wahlburgers is diverted when N*SYNC's Joey Fatone asks his advice for his hot dog joint, Fat One's.  Back in MA., Paul have a secret diner to test the food and service at the Lynnfield Wahlburgers.

As Paul visits potential San Francisco locations, he finds a meatless patty he wants to put on the menu. Paul gives the burger to Mark to try. In Chicago, Donnie asks Danny Wood to convince the rest of the New Kids to include Wahlburgers gear on the tour.

With Wahlburgers on the verge of closing a deal to open hundreds of locations in the Asia Pacific, Mark gives Paul the final say in this new partnership. Donnie, unable to make the event announcing the deal, prepares his video speech.
Mark embarks on a packed business trip across the U.S. that includes an opportunity to create the first Wahlburgers action figure.
In Nashville on tour with NKOTB, Donnie scouts a potential location with Joey MacIntyre and N*SYNC's Chris Kirkpatrick where they join up with country music star John Rich.

programmes.st: Nice Day For a Wahl Wedding
programmes.d: When the New Kids on the Block World Tour stops in Philadelphia, Donnie visits the new Wahlburgers location with his son Elijah and his friends.

When Mark attends the VIP party at the Las Vegas Wahlburgers, Paul enlists Penn and Teller to make the event magical. Meanwhile, in Hingham, Donnie suggests that Alma cook a meal as a way of introducing herself to all the new Wahlburgers employees.
Jeff learns a bitter lesson when an old friend steals a lucrative deal right out from under him. Meanwhile, much-loved employee Christine departs Direct Liquidation.
Jeff's makes a big promise and decides to host an auction to sell used karts when a local go-kart track goes out of business.
Jeff has one day to clear out a Chinese grocery store full of exotic and vile stock.
Jeff makes an impulse buy. Meanwhile, Daniel ends up with a truckload of shoes that are all the same size.
In Chicago, a brawl erupts in a fast food restaurant between several employees and one customer. In North Carolina, a car rental agent keeps his cool while dealing with a difficult customer.
Passengers on a departing plane attempt to vote a disruptive woman off the aircraft. A brawl breaks out at a home-goods store in Arizona after someone allegedly cuts the line.
In Nashville, Tennessee, a dissatisfied restaurant patron tests the tolerance of her fellow diners. A tech-savvy New Yorker sends his robot to fetch fish food, delighting a pet store employee.

In Brookhaven, Pennsylvania, a pizza delivery man helps police apprehend a suspect. In Philadelphia, a gas station customer rudely wakes up a napping cashier. A store clerk in Los Angeles risks her life to fight off a would-be robber.

In Swampscott, Massachusetts, a woman and a contractor face off over noisy construction in her neighborhood. After reportedly being told it's too early to order a chicken product, a woman attacks the employees through a drive thru window.

In Florida, tempers flare during a flight's deboarding process as an impulsive passenger attempts to force his way down the aisle. In New Jersey, a mall-goer's unique outlook on life stuns the man interviewing him.

In a series first, an openly gay boss goes undercover! Can the boss measure up while manning the floor in the lingerie department? The Boss is hot under the collar when an employee continues to bad mouth his company.

Jane Grote Abell, Owner of Donato's Pizza, goes undercover to get an inside slice of the family business. The boss learns that the pizzas aren't the only things getting baked at one store. One store's archaic computer system leaves the boss in a bad mood.

Anthony Wedo, CEO of Buffets Inc., travels from his corner office to the back of the house. The boss breaks cover when flooded with a dishwasher's nasty attitude. The high-energy Boss meets his match when faced with an unruly cash register.

New buyer Tommy is larger than life and looking for a big score at an auction in Brampton. Roy arrives with an intern, eager to mentor for free labor. Rick and Cindy hedge their bets and Ursula would rather be shopping.

programmes.st: Honeymoon Capital Of The Storage World
programmes.d: The buyers attend an auction in Niagara Falls. Rick and Cindy wonder if Cindy will be recognized in her old hometown. Ursula is in a sticky situation, Roy is better off undead, and Paul and Bogart visit the Ripley's Believe It or Not! Museum.

Paul, Bogart, and their life coach go to an auction in Toronto. If any problems arise, they must “hug it out.” Ursula encourages her daughter to run away to join the circus. Rick takes charge, Cindy doesn't notice, and Roy sets his glass on fire.

programmes.st: Between A Brawk And A Hard Place
programmes.d: Roy reaches new levels of distraction by training a talking parrot to insult the rest of the buyers at an auction in Etobicoke. Rick and Cindy do some detective work, Ursula could use a hand, and Paul and Bogart make money where the sun doesn't shine.

Paul wants his son to be a father someday but is unhappy when Bogart brings a “practice baby” to an auction. Ursula finds out if blondes do have more fun. Rick and Cindy try silent but deadly tactics and no one notices when Roy is more honest.

programmes.st: The Birds And The Bees And The Bulls
programmes.d: The buyers learn lessons at an auction in Ontario. Paul and Bogart discover that listening to each other is useless. Glasses affect Ursula's bidding. Roy learns that his true calling is a frat boy and Rick and Cindy get too much information.

Ursula goes ape at an auction when Roy says her coat makes her look like a monkey. Paul and Bogart set a bad example for returning buyer Jeff Gardner and his son. It takes a lot for Rick and Cindy to bid on their locker and Roy's out for blood.

Roy brings noisemakers to an auction in Emery Village but the other buyers aren't feeling it. Rick and Cindy prefer to clown around on their own time. Paul and Bogart boogie with some intergalactic performers, and all Ursula wants is a strong coffee.

programmes.st: May The Schwarz Be With You
programmes.d: Jeff Schwarz, aka “The Liquidator,” is back and is causing as much chaos as possible.
A professional hitman faces a group of assassins after the boss of a crime syndicate suspects disloyalty due to his attendance at Workaholics Anonymous meetings.
Hellboy and a rookie B.P.R.D. agent in the 1950s are sent to the Appalachians, where they discover a remote community dominated by witches and led by the sinister local demon, the Crooked Man.

Having just returned home, decorated U.S. Marine Captain Brad Paxton's (Gary Dourdan) wife, Kate, is kidnapped by a terrorist group while working in Morocco. He is forced back into action for a daring and deadly operation to save the woman he loves.

Jonathan Majors (Creed III) and Glen Powell (Top Gun: Maverick) star in the epic and inspirational true story of two elite US fighter pilots during the Korean War. Their heroic sacrifices would ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.
In this thrilling WWII epic, a US pilot shot down over Germany must singlehandedly battle Nazi troops to thwart a doomsday plot involving a superbomb that can destroy whole cities.

Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves Infinites come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.
Hellboy and a rookie B.P.R.D. agent in the 1950s are sent to the Appalachians, where they discover a remote community dominated by witches and led by the sinister local demon, the Crooked Man.

Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.
Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.
Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags, and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.
Seven friends, recent college graduates, are searching for a place in the real world as they face issues of career and commitment. Rating: R
Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.
Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags, and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.
Neil Simon comedy that follows a couple's mishaps as they travel to New York for a job interview. A series of comedic disasters follows that might make one think twice before visiting the Big Apple.
Louis hopes diplomacy will hide his duplicity as he works to undermine Leopold.
Has Louis finally learnt the identity of the man in the iron mask?

Fed up with the rivalry between the Musketeers and the Red Guards, the King calls a contest between them to settle which one is stronger once and for all. D'Artagnan is determined to be chosen to fight so he can prove himself worthy to be a Musketeer.

Following the death of a young girl, The Musketeers' investigation into her missing friend leads them to the world of a high-born woman. They put aside their animosity towards Cardinal when his life is placed in danger and rescue this extraordinary woman.

Fed up with the rivalry between the Musketeers and the Red Guards, the King calls a contest between them to settle which one is stronger once and for all. D'Artagnan is determined to be chosen to fight so he can prove himself worthy to be a Musketeer.

The Musketeers come under siege in a convent whilst protecting the Queen after an attempt is made on her life by a crack-shot assassin. Fearful for their lives the Mother Superior and nuns help the Musketeers to defend the convent.
Tensions escalate between Mary and Francis when Vatican inquisitors perform barbaric acts on anyone suspected of being a Protestant.  After a brave proclamation, Lord Condé is abducted.
With a holiday celebration around the corner, Bash uncovers what could be the answer to Francis finally escaping the oppressive thumb of Lord Narcisse, and the two formulate a daring plan.

In the aftermath of an attack on the castle, a blood-thirsty Francis makes a startling decision that will forever change his rule as the King of France, causing him to track the missing Narcisse  with a newfound lust for revenge.

Mary takes action to save Condé when she learns the Vatican is hunting him for bearing the branded mark of the Dark Riders. Francis devises a plan to put an end to the Dark Riders legend, which puts Bash at risk.
Mary finds out the truth from Greer about rumors going around Court, forcing Mary to do something she never thought possible. Francis finds himself in a growing rivalry with Condé for Mary.
As the castle prepares for the Winter's Ease Feast, King Antoine (guest star Ben Aldridge) of Navarre reveals to Francis and Mary England's plan for  revenge against France.
As Mary and Francis investigate who was behind the poisoning of King Henry, they unearth secrets of the past which force Mary to confront her feelings for Condé as she attempts to move forward.
Mary's mother (guest star Amy Brenneman) returns to advise Mary that her throne is in jeopardy. Mary makes a shocking proposition to Condé (Sean Teale), along with a bold move to reclaim her throne.
When King Antoine (guest star Ben Aldridge) threatens to tell Francis of Mary  and Condé's evolving relationship, Francis makes a shocking move.

When Catherine becomes suspicious that Mary and Condé are having an affair, Mary risks Catherine discovering just how deep her betrayal goes. Francis becomes gravely ill after he collapses and Bash's life is in jeopardy.
FBI Special Agent Olivia Dunham (ANNA TORV) investigates a fatal international flight, recruiting Dr. Walter Bishop (JOHN NOBLE) and his son (JOSHUA JACKSON) to help.
The unlikely trio forms a partnership and investigates the link between a wildly accelerated pregnancy and an "old" newborn.
After a horrific bus incident, Olivia, Peter and Bishop uncover a man who has visions of Pattern-related disturbances before they happen.
After a deadly explosion in New York, our unlikely threesome investigate a strange cylinder found at the scene that's completely unharmed by the surrounding devastation.
When a simple man is discovered who has the ability to harness electricity, dangerous and deadly occurrences follow — and our unlikely trio investigates this super-charged oddity.
When a woman with a rare disease inexplicably causes excruciating pain and subsequent death to those she encounters, the circumstances point to illegal drug trials… or worse.

programmes.st: In Which We Meet Mr. Jones
programmes.d: When a strange parasite attaches itself to the internal organs of a dying agent, Agent Dunham rushes to Germany to meet with a prisoner who reveals details of a much larger threat.
Liv investigates the murder of a private eye who was stabbed in the head with an ice pick.
Liv and Clive investigate the death of an old school drag queen, which leads Liv to eat and shift into the queen's brain. Meanwhile, Ravi has a request for Major.
Liv makes a devastating discovery.
The human versus zombie war finally comes to a head. Rose McIver, Rahul Kohli, Malcolm Goodwin, Robert Buckley, David Anders, Aly Michalka and Bryce Hodgson also star.
In the series premiere, a medical resident turned zombie works in the coroner's office. With each brain she eats, she inherits the corpse's memories, helping her solve crimes.

programmes.st: Brother, Can You Spare A Brain?
programmes.d: Liv, Ravi and Clive work together to solve the mysterious death of a painter. After eating his brain, Liv finds herself consumed with passion. JUDY REYES (Scrubs) guest stars.
A victim turns out to be a sociopathic hit man responsible for the murder of a tech entrepreneur. Liv and Ravi dig deeper into a supposed zombie sighting. Major moves on.
Liv is surprised when Clive is quick to refuse her help in solving a murder, so Liv and Ravi investigate on their own. Meanwhile, Major begins searching for a roommate.
When a music prodigy is kidnapped, it's discovered that a sequence of flashing lights appeared at the abduction — which Walter links back to his bunkmate at St. Claire's Hospital.
While investigating a mystifying incident at Massive Dynamic, Olivia seeks to rid her consciousness of Agent Scott and Peter's past catches up with him.
This week we look to debunk a few predatory myths from our oceans to deserts.
From oceans to mountains we follow the paths of animal migrations.
We see examples of people making a difference to help our planet.
Philippe joins the Department of Natural Resources to tag tiger sharks in Port Royal Sound
We look at the wonderful world of insects.
This week we head to the beautiful landscape of Glacier National Park.
We see how nature can sometimes be the best classroom.
We see how science helps us prepare for natural disasters.

People have labored on some gigantic undertakings such as roads, bridges, and canals that link oceans. These feats of engineering have allowed cities to grow, but now they are also allowing us to travel into space.
For as long as man has been alive, he has fought to defend what is rightfully his and fought even harder to take what is not. He soon figured out, the man with the biggest weapon has the advantage.

People aren't the only ones that need to travel. Our way of life has always relied on the transportation of cargo, freight and raw materials. Transport has needed to evolve to keep up with the demand.
Mankind has proved time and time again that they are more than capable of dreaming big. Ferocious ambition has produced both world-renowned monuments and monumental gaffs.
Throughout history, ancestors have always strived to go higher, bigger, deeper, further.
Exploring some of history's most ingenious, yet lesser-known engineering solutions.
Building structures and machines to harness water.
Migration, travel and trade are all key components of human life.
The Great Lakes are sometimes referred to as inland seas; they are the largest freshwater system in the world. Naked Science examines the early history of these amazing bodies
The Earth hurtles through space protected by an invisible force field, known as a magnetosphere.
Almost every culture on Earth tells the story of an ancient flood – details vary but the basic plot is the same - An angry God wipes out an unrepentant population.

programmes.t: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programmes.d: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.
In Blumhouse's continuation of the cult hit The Craft, an eclectic foursome of aspiring teenage witches gets more than they bargained for as they lean into their newfound powers.
Ambition seduces, and power corrupts in a nerve-wracking thriller from Academy Award-nominated director George Clooney (Good Night, and Good Luck). Rating: R
A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.
Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

The action and comedy never stop when Martin Lawrence and Will Smith reunite as out-of-control, trash-talking buddy cops. Bullets fly, cars crash, and laughs explode as they pursue a whacked-out drug lord from the streets of Miami to the barrios of Cuba.

Billy Crystal and Jack Palance ride the range as a middle-aged urban SUV jockey and a hardened and weathered cowpoke in this Western tale of a cattle drive that becomes a journey of self-discovery for a band of City Slickers.

programmes.t: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
programmes.d: Frozen in the '60s, secret agent Austin Powers is thawed back into action to once again battle his archenemy, Dr. Evil. With his sexy sidekick, Ms. Kensington, Austin must stop Dr. Evil's outrageous plot to control the world.

programmes.t: Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me
programmes.d: The International Man of Mystery must travel back to the Swinging Sixties, track down his stolen mojo, and thwart Dr. Evil's plot to destroy the world.

After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.

Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.
In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

Ronna needs to make some extra cash. Simon wants to escape to Vegas for the weekend. Adam and Zack want to stay out of trouble. But it's not just another night in the life of these unusual characters.

Bernie Lootz (William H. Macy), is the unluckiest man in Vegas. His bad luck is so contagious that Shelly Kaplow (Alec Baldwin), the last of the old-time mobsters, uses Bernie to kill the high rollers' action at his casino.
In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.
A sprawling epic about family, faith, power, and oil: the story chronicles the life of Daniel Plainview, who transforms himself from a down-and-out silver miner into a self-made oil tycoon.

San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.
A young couple is trapped in a remote town where a dangerous religious cult of children believes that everyone over age 18 must be killed.

Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.
Ignoring Camp Crystal Lake’s bloody legacy, one by one they fall victim to the maniacal Jason who stalks them at every turn...

When serial killer Charles Lee Ray is mortally wounded in a police shoot-out, he uses a voodoo spell to transfer his soul into Chucky, a Good Guys doll. Young Andy receives the doll as a birthday gift, and Chucky soon resumes his killing spree.

A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

Five friends are holed up in a remote cabin, where they discover a Book Of The Dead. They unwittingly summon demons living in the nearby woods, which in turn possess the youngsters until only one remains intact to fight for survival.
Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.
Almost a year has passed since vampires decimated Barrow, Alaska’s population. Stella, mourning her husband’s murder, has been traveling the world trying to convince others that vampires exist.
Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.

A former Army Ranger, now working as a DEA agent, is called in to investigate the disappearance of a drill sergeant and several cadets during a training mission that went disastrously wrong in the Panamanian jungle.
Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.
A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

Harrison Ford stars as the wrongly convicted Dr. Richard Kimble, and Tommy Lee Jones is U.S. Marshal Sam Gerard, his relentless pursuer, in this intense thriller based on the hit television series of the 1960s.
Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.
The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.
A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.

Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike anything the world has ever seen.

After witnessing a shocking crime, a young rock band is unexpectedly thrust into a life-or-death battle to escape the clutches of a diabolical club owner (Patrick Stewart) and his ruthless henchmen in this white-knuckle thriller.
An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

Caesar’s a guy who launders money for the mob. What’s the last thing that would come between a sleazy wise guy like Caesar and that money? A couple of women with brains to die for and bodies to match.

When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege by the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

In this final chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Neo, Morpheus, and Trinity battle to defend Zion against the machines' onslaught that has enslaved the human race. And Neo faces the consequences of the choice made in The Matrix Reloaded.
Four young adults are gunned down inside an affluent home in a quiet suburb of Houston, Texas.
A bloodbath inside a Beverly Hills mansion sparks a highly publicized investigation.
The discovery of a burned body on the side of the road kickstarts a race to find a killer.
A homicide at the intersection of a teenage daughter and her boyfriend who can't get out from underneath a mother's overbearing eye.

Calvin decides to splurge on an expensive jacket, then worries it's too special to risk wearing outside the house. Also, Dave and Gemma worry their new friends' daughter is a bad influence on Grover.

A look at the charms and challenges of small town life in America during the first half of the 20th century, presented entirely in color.
Witness the highs and lows of 1950s America, from consumerism to McCarthyism and beyond: in color.
From Buffalo Bill to the construction of the Hoover Dam, this is the story of America's Wild West in color.

A slip of the axe blade slices Morgan too deep; Marty targets a wolf pack on a killing spree; Tom digs out.
Morgan is sidelined while he gets back on his feet; Marty fights to stay in the game and Eustace makes a critical trade to protect his future.
Marty doubles down on a new strategy to keep from losing more ground; Morgan and Margaret defend what's theirs and Jason's hunt for land becomes an ordeal.
Marty fights for every last dollar as his season goes into freefall; Eustace and Preston experiment in barnyard engineering and Jason gets locked out of a new home.
An early thaw puts Morgan's supply drop on thin ice; Marty hunts the beasts of Kodiak Island and Tom makes the most of his unprecedented winning streak.
After finding out their boat was stolen, Cyril and his crew trek through the dense Amazon jungle and tread through waters where piranhas, caimans, and anacondas prowl on the hunt.

Cyril is on a mission to catch a brutal and fearless predator capable of ramming sharks to death. Waist deep in shark waters, Cyril gets relentlessly beaten by violent waves while casting his line from Christmas Island.

Imagine a giant 500 lb creature armed with a deadly eight-inch dagger-like barb capable of stabbing and injecting you with one of the most painful toxins in the animal kingdom...That's the unsettling, elusive ghost Cyril is after in Thailand.

The wild coast of South Africa is known for its deadly shark attacks and slippery, sheer cliffs that have cost many people their lives - but it's also home to one of Africa's most brutal fighting fish: the powerful Kob.

Cyril travels to one the most remote and dangerous environments in the world on the hunt for the largest freshwater fish in Africa, the Nile Perch, a massive beast with a cavernous mouth that can swallow big prey whole.

An early melt unleashes the local bears weeks ahead of schedule in the Great Alaska Range; Jason hunt for a home is finally over
Morgan's horses go missing just as the local bears are waking for spring; Rich's marathon lion hunt turns into an epic chase and Tom goes after America's largest game.

programmes.st: To Every Thing There Is A Season

Roy rolls the dice shipping the world's largest drum set, while Chris and Robbie land a less-than-noteworthy Mobile Tattoo Parlor.

programmes.st: It's My Party & I'll Shoot You If I Want To

Jarrett deals with his biggest pain in the ass yet after he wins a giant 40-foot colon. Meanwhile it's NO fun and games for Roy when he battles the owner of a giant video game.

programmes.d: Roy's patience is tested when he ships an iconic piece of ghostly movie history, while Darwinian Theory is proven when the Two Blondes attempt a load of dinosaurs.

Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer.  They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960s and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940s and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capital City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!
Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War-era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!
Tempers flare and prices soar as the buyers confront aggressive guest auctioneer Jeff Schwartz, aka “The Liquidator.”
Guest auctioneer Patrick Pecker brings “the full Pecker” to the auction, fuelling his longstanding feud with Roy.
Roy suits up in full army gear to declare war on the buyers in Scarborough.
Roy’s paltry gifts are no match for Cindy’s foul mood at the auction in Scarborough.

programmes.st: The Seven Habits of Highly Effective Instigators
programmes.d: The Thornhill buyers run for cover when a self-help CD gives Roy a new lease on his egomaniacal life.
A Brampton auction near some of the gang’s old high school proves they’re all still rowdy teenagers at heart.
Paul’s locker addiction reaches new highs (and lows) at the Wasaga Beach auction.
Rick and Cindy bring a psychic to help them land the best lockers in Don Mills.
As Rick and Cindy try to give up smoking at an auction in Leslieville, they cope by making sure everyone else suffers right along with them.
A wedding-bound Roy arrives at a Guelph auction in his tuxedo.

programmes.st: The Lame, Sick and The Crazy
programmes.d: With Bogart on crutches and Cindy nursing a cold, it’s a tough day at the auction for all the buyers in Guelph.
Excitement runs high as Mississauga plays host to a charity auction of highend storage crates.
With a dangerous hurricane approaching, the team scrambles to find evidence of what might be buried beneath the swamp before the storm can wipe out their efforts.

New evidence suggests there was French activity on Oak Island decades before the discovery of the Money Pit and the team may have finally uncovered definitive proof the swamp was manmade centuries ago.
Excitement abounds when Gary uncovers an ancient tunneling tool in the swamp, and the team obtains hard, scientific evidence suggesting they may have finally located the original Money Pit.
New, hard evidence suggests that Fred Nolan's theory that a ship was buried in the swamp centuries ago, may be true.
The team may be closer than ever to shutting down the flood tunnels when they discover large amounts of coconut fiber in the uplands.

Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.
Kirk and the U.S.S. Enterprise must combat parasitic aliens.
Spock must return to Vulcan to meet his intended future wife, betrothed from childhood.
The Enterprise encounters an alien who claims to be the Greek god Apollo.
The Enterprise encounters an ancient Earth probe bent on the sterilization of all life.
A transporter accident places Captain Kirk's landing party in an alternate universe, where the Enterprise is in the service of a barbarically brutal empire.
Kirk attempts to assist a primitive people that are ruled over by a computer named Vaal.
The USS Enterprise encounters the wrecked USS Constellation and its distraught commodore.
Very alien visitors to our galaxy attempt to connect with human consciousness but miss, winding up tapping into the regions of human nightmares instead.
The Enterprise is taken over by a group of androids who are working for Kirk's old nemesis, Harry Mudd.
While returning to the Enterprise aboard the shuttlecraft, Kirk, Spock, McCoy and a seriously ill Federation diplomat find themselves kidnapped by an energized cloud.
Tensions run high when the Enterprise transports ambassadors to the Babel conferences.
The Enterprise crew becomes embroiled in a local power struggle on a tribal planet.
A landing party, including the command staff, is infected with a disease that causes rapid aging and senility.
The Enterprise must deal with a creature from Kirk's past that feeds on human blood.
Kirk and the Enterprise computer become detectives after Scotty is accused of murdering women on a pleasure planet.
The Enterprise is overrun by furry creatures while tangling with Klingons and bureaucrats.
Kirk, Chekov, and Uhura are kidnapped and forced to participate in a series of gladiatorial games.

Grand Nagus Zek, the leader of the Ferengi Alliance, pays a surprise visit to lowly Quark's Bar to host a conference on exploiting the Gamma Quadrant -- and names Quark, not his own son, as his successor.
An alien criminal from the other side of the wormhole tempts Odo by telling the shape-shifter he can put the changeling in contact with others like himself.
Sisko, Kira, and Bashir are stranded in a war-torn world where it is impossible for the combatants to die.
Chief O'Brien is reluctantly "adopted" as a spiritual leader by a Bajoran village that annually follows the "Storyteller" to fight a demon of the town's collective fears.
A stubborn old Bajoran farmer forces Kira to take a good look at how much she has changed since her alliance with the Federation.
When members of the station find their fantasies coming to life, it becomes the prelude to a very real danger, which threatens everyone.
While an alien entity wreaks havoc with the station's computer, the irrepressible Lwaxana Troi sets her sights on romance--with Odo.
Odo is caught in the middle when an alien influence pits Kira against Sisko in a deadly power struggle.

Kira is forced to re-examine her post-occupation prejudices about Cardassians when her running battle of wits with a jailed man claiming to be a notorious death camp leader is actually his remorseful file clerk.

programmes.st: In The Hands Of The Prophets
programmes.d: When a Bajoran spiritual leader objects to Keiko's secular teachings, she threatens to destroy the alliance between Bajor and the Federation.
Kira risks her life, and war with the Cardassians, to rescue a  mythical Bajoran hero from a distant prison colony.
Relieved of her post and sent back to Bajor, Kira helps to reveal the hidden force behind The Circle—and a greater secret that could destroy them all.
While Sisko leads a daring last stand against the Bajoran takeover forces, Kira and Dax embark on a desperate mission to reveal the truth about the coup.
The crew must fight for Jadzia's life when a desperate Trill takes the group hostage and steals the Dax symbiont.
A young Cardassian, orphaned in the war and raised by Bajorans, causes turmoil on the station when his people attempt to reclaim him.
After falling in love with a woman whose species is unable to walk in "normal" gravity, Bashir develops a technology that could free her of her wheelchair forever.
A Ferengi female, defying the law and disguising herself as a male, risks it all when she falls in love with Quark.
Noncorporeal aliens study the Enterprise crew as they respond to a fatal viral infection brought on board from an away mission.
Enterprise journeys to Babel with a Tellarite ambassador on board for peace talks with the Andorians, when a distress call from Shran is received.
Archer tries to unify the Andorians, Tellarites and Vulcans in a plan to capture a marauder ship threatening to destabilize the region.
Archer visits Shran's icy homeworld to find an Andorian subspecies called the Aenar, to determine their connection to the marauder destroying ships in the region.
While Enterprise visits Earth for the launch of Columbia, Phlox is kidnapped and forced to help the Klingons deal with a grave threat toward their species.
With Columbia's help, the Enterprise crew grapples with sabotage to their ship as they pursue the truth behind the kidnapping of Phlox.
As a gift for negotiating with the Orion Syndicate, Captain Archer receives three Orion Slave Girls.
In the mirror universe, Commander Archer mutinies against Captain Forrest in order to capture a future Earth ship found in Tholian space.

programmes.st: In a Mirror, Darkly, Part II
programmes.d: In the mirror universe, Archer commandeers the 23rd-century Defiant from the Tholians and uses it in a nefarious power grab.
A xenophobic faction of humanity threatens to undermine talks to form a new coalition of planets.
A human isolationist leader threatens to destroy Starfleet Command unless all aliens leave Earth immediately.
Six years in the future, an emotional Captain Archer and the crew return to Earth to face the decommission of Enterprise and signing of the Federation charter.

The maiden crew of the starship Enterprise seizes the long overdue opportunity to gain independence for Humans from the Vulcans by venturing into untracked space to deliver a Klingon messenger to his home world of Kronos.

Archer must choose between the safety of his crew and doing the right thing as the vulnerable Enterprise must survive while trying to uphold justice between two different unknown alien ships in battle.

An Enterprise away-team fights delusions and paranoid suspicions caused by an alien wildflower's hallucinogenic pollen while stranded overnight to wait out a violent windstorm on a beautiful unexplored planet.
While attempting to repair the warp engine of an alien ship, Trip inadvertently becomes impregnated and the Enterprise must relocate the ship before the baby is due.

Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!
Picard’s only hope for a future rests within the Nexus...and a legendary captain from the past.
They call themselves the Borg – a half-machine collective with a sole purpose: to conquer and assimilate all races.
When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

programmes.t: Star Trek: The Motion Picture - The Director's Edition
programmes.d: The U.S.S. Enterprise proudly soars again in this new, beautifully restored Director's Edition of the original Star Trek movie classic. This edition features enhanced visual effects and a new sound mix, supervised by legendary director Robert Wise.

programmes.t: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programmes.d: 23rd century: The Federation Starship U.S.S. Enterprise™ is on routine training maneuvers, and Admiral James T. Kirk seems resigned to the fact that this inspection may well be the last space mission of his career. But Khan is back...

programmes.t: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programmes.d: Admiral Kirk’s defeat of Khan and the creation of the planet Genesis are empty victories. Spock is dead, and McCoy is inexplicably being driven insane. Then a surprise visit from Sarek, Spock’s father, provides a startling revelation.
On a rescue mission to an alien shipwrecked training mission, they discover one of its trainees to be a human.
Dr. Crusher's fear of losing loved ones becomes real when her worries create an alternate reality.
The crew of the Enterprise enters into orbit around the home planet of their former crew-mate, Tasha Yar, where they encounter her sister.

When the head of the Klingon high council passes on, Picard finds himself in the middle of the struggle for the now-vacant position. Meanwhile, Worf re-unites with a past love, only to find he now has a son.
Riker has to quit his birthday party during a so-far uneventful patrol voyage at the Neutral Zone to head an away team when a Romulan secret base is found on a planet which was believed uninhabited.
Before leaving for Starfleet Academy, Wesley Crusher accompanies Captain Picard on a dangerous mission.
As an unknown force drags the Enterprise, Deanna Troi struggles with the loss of her powers.
Data tries to comprehend the complex emotions between O'Brien and Keiko, who are about to be married.
After being fired upon by a Cardassian vessel, Picard races against time to find out the facts behind the Cardassian commander's claim that the Federation attacked one of their outposts.
While answering a distress call, Picard finds himself not sure of exactly who he is dealing with, but he's sure he's NOT dealing with the planet's version of The Devil, as she claims to be.
Effects of passing through a wormhole give the Enterprise crew a sense that they were unconscious for more than the thirty seconds they've been led to believe.
Commander William Riker has been on an acculturation mission under an alias for months on the Arkonian planet.

While the Enterprise is in a star-base, Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge gets a very special visitor, brilliant engineering designer Dr. Leah Brahms, who he feels to know almost intimately as a 'hologram version' of herself with 'whom' he bonded.
The Enterprise has finally tracked the missing starship USS Britain. Counselor Deanna Troi senses trouble with the life on board and joins Riker's boarding party.
Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge and an old friend fight to defeat a parasite that is trying to transform them into another species.

When assigned to investigate an unknown probe, Lt. Barclay is electrocuted through a shuttlecraft's computer, where he receives an unexplainable boost of confidence and a vast increase in his knowledge.
The Enterprise is at Tegus 3, to host the Federation archaeologists council's annual symposium, where Picard is to give the key-note lecture on its enigmatic ruins, now forbidden to outsiders.
Voyager's quest to return home is aided by a visitor from the future – Admiral Kathryn Janeway.
Janeway risks Voyager's shortcut home in order to destroy the Borg and save millions of lives.
While searching for a missing officer, Captain Kathryn Janeway and the crew of the Starship Voyager are swept 70,000 light years from home.
The Voyager crew launches a daring rescue mission to save two officers trapped in a subterranean city facing disaster.
Tensions rise between the merged Starfleet and Maquis crews when the ship becomes trapped inside a star that's collapsed upon itself.
When Paris and Janeway are sent back in time, they must decide whether to violate the Prime Directive by warning residents of a planet facing annihilation.
Neelix faces certain death when an alien race stricken by a devastating plague "harvests" his lungs.
The crew discovers that a nebula is not what it seems, and Paris invites his fellow officers to share a little "R&R" in his holodeck program.
The discovery of a wormhole in deep space raises the crew's hopes of finding a shortcut home.
After Paris is convicted of a murder he swears he didn't commit, Tuvok must play detective to clear him.
Kim confronts life and death issues when he's held against his will by an alien race.
An alien leader has the technology that could send the crew 40,000 light years closer to home -- but refuses to share it with them.
The crew realizes there's a traitor on board after Federation technology turns upon an enemy warship.
Janeway sends the ship's doctor on his first Away Mission: rescue the crew members who have vanished in the holodeck's version of Beowulf.
An encounter with a strange nebula leaves Chakotay brain-dead and the crew battling a powerful force that seems to be taking over their minds.
Voyager's half-human, half-Klingon Chief Engineer Torres is split into two beings by a scientist desperate to cure the plague that's destroying his people.
A painful chapter in Neelix's past is reopened when the man responsible for killing his family beams aboard Voyager.

Successfully using the retrovirus to turn an entire hive ship of Wraith into humans the team returns to Atlantis with their prisoners in stasis. Weir continues to defend her leadership in the face of an independent review being conducted by the IOA.

The team comes across a small village with a revered leader. Beckett soon becomes so enamored by his host he brings him to Atlantis. But soon, McKay discovers that Lucius is using some sort of pheromone to enchant those around him.

Exploring a village, the team is suddenly attacked and taken prisoner as Ronon had unknowingly lured the Wraith there. The villagers set Sheppard and Teyla free, who mobilize a strike force. When they return, the village has been devastated.

Using the communications stones, Lt. Scott and Camile Wray use their time back on Earth to visit those they’ve left behind. Aboard Destiny, the crew stumbles upon a piece of Ancient technology that carries the promise of a way home.

Everyone is shocked when a member of the crew is found dead from a gunshot wound. While it appears to be suicide, the gun is nowhere to be found…until it shows up in Col. Young’s (Louis Ferreira) quarters and he becomes the number one suspect.

An alien vessel appears in Destiny’s path and launches an attack, capturing Chloe. Col. Young must use the stones again to get aboard the ship and try to rescue Chloe. He quickly realizes, however, that Chloe isn’t the only prisoner aboard.

Suspecting an alien tracking device may be hidden somewhere aboard the Destiny, Col. Young and Lt. Scott search the ship’s hull. While distracted by the search, a group aboard the Destiny puts in action a coup that has life-threatening consequences.

On a distant planet the Stargate has become a symbol to the people, and some believe that the gods will return through it to reward the faithful. SG-1 realizes that those gods are the Goa'uld and warn of the danger they may face.

The team agrees that an easy VR simulator is a useless training tool against the Goa'uld. Teal'c lets it learn from him, but as he plays, the game sends a shock each time he dies, and if he doesn't defeat the game, the chair will kill him.

Teal'c, having finally been cleared to live off-base, settles into his new neighborhood. His neighbors love him. He's quiet and he has become a sort of protector of his community but not everybody is as pleased about Teal'c's civilian assimilation.

Alec Colson is claiming he has shocking proof that the government is covering up a liaison with aliens, and that Earth was almost destroyed by an alien invasion, Colson gives all nations involved 24 hours to come clean or he'll do it for them.

Teal'c and Bra'tac have just returned from the planet Ha'ktyl, where they tried to convince the warrior-woman rebel leader Ishta, to wait until her fellow insurgent Jaffa grow numerous enough to wage war against all the Goa'uld system lords at once.

The Stargate is missing. Upon investigation the team notice a scientist tagging the stargate with a locator beacon. It looks like this is the work of The Trust taking whatever ruthless action they deem necessary to protect Earth from alien invaders.

An old IDC comes through; Send M.A.L.P. The M.A.L.P. telemetry shows that the person sending the transmission is Carter but Carter is in the control room at SGC. The Carter on the other side explains that she is a Replicator.

A mission has been greenlit to take the Prometheus to the Pegasus galaxy. Jackson wants in. O'Neill feels he is too valuable to risk. The decision is overridden by the mission commander, none other than Gen. Hammond, now head of home world security.

When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector.  Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums.  When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met.  In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story.  Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway.  When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room.  Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler.  Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum.  The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing.  Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programmes.d: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house.  Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company.  Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up).  Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programmes.st: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programmes.d: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house.  While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez.  The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella.  Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby.  They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs.  Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programmes.d: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programmes.st: The Addams Family Goes To School
programmes.d: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read.  When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy.  Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm. Lucas' life is endangered when a snake crawls into his bed.
While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.
Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.
Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.
Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a good friend from Lucas' past. But it's pleasure before business. Mario has been hired to kill Lucas.
Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.
The lazy Jackman brother's mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town. The family patriarch becomes marshal and deputizes his sons.
Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.
Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.
Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.
When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.
The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal who is now crippled and working for Lucas McCain.
Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch. Gibbs, a rodeo rider wanted by the law, begins stirring up trouble.
A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain to revenge himself on Lucas.
A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully ridicules his manner of speech and dress and provokes the Count to challenge him to a duel.
A new bank opens and Banker Hamilton hires a slow-witted gunman to guard the safe. When some of the gunman's old outlaw friends arrive in town they propose he join them in robbing the bank.
When Mark tries to play Cupid between Lucas and a stranger who arrives in North Fork, the girl's older brothers accuse him of trifling with her affections and challenge him to fight.
An arch-criminal has been run out of New Orleans and is passing through North Fork. Spotting the McCain ranch, he tells McCain he wants to buy it.
Young Dan Willard takes on Marshal Micah Torrence's job. With no experience, he takes a tough stand with a bunch of Texas cowhands whose high spirits are evident at the saloon.
Lucas and Mark are returning from a big cattle sale when the stage is robbed by three outlaws. Lucas, desperate to recover the money that was stolen, is determined to pursue the outlaws.
Lucas gets in trouble when he accuses the foreman of a neighboring ranch of rustling some of his cattle.
An Argentine family moves to North Fork. The townspeople are unfriendly to them, making fun of their clothing and customs. The Argentinean adult immigrant is openly hostile in return.
Lucas and Mark find themselves exposed to anthrax after they adopt a stray horse whose owner has been killed in a gunfight.
After the end of the Civil War, General Phil Sheridan, who has been appointed Governor of the New Mexico Territory, is on an inspection tour of the country.
A famous gunfighter marries and decides to retire. He and his wife settle down in North Fork and open a store, but three outlaws arrive in town looking to best him in a gunfight.
An old friend of Lucas McCain's, a traveling photographer, comes to North Fork plying his trade. When a murder is committed, the photographer is accused of the crime.
The townsfolk of North Fork decide to give a young couple a shivaree celebration. When the drunken crowd gets out of hand and roughs up the bride-to-be, the young groom challenges them.
When a young boy from Brooklyn is accused of murder, Mark, believing the boy's claim of innocence, hides him until he can find the real killer.
U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart arrives in North Fork in search of renegade Indians suspected of the brutal killing of a Texas Ranger and his family.
Sid Fallon tries to blackmail former gambler Julia Andueza into allowing him to use her boarding house as a gambling hall and saloon.
Lucas puts his life in jeopardy when he agrees to testify in a murder case where the first witness was killed before he could testify, and the killer is still at large.
Outlaw Sam Morley falls in love with a young woman who has a serious illness and asks Lucas to turn him in for the reward and use the money to pay for her medical care.
Lucas welcomes his old friend Tom Birch, who once saved his life, unaware that the man is now a bank robber on the run with his gang.
Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.
An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.
The Kanamits, 9-foot tall aliens, arrive on Earth with one lofty goal: To Serve Man.
A compulsive gambler cajoles his friend to use his telekinesis to affect the results of the gambling tables in Las Vegas.
An alien who crash-lands into a remote mountain village stirs up the villagers' fears and animosity, but he befriends a little boy and gives him a mysterious present.

programmes.st: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
programmes.d: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.
Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.
In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there, and an overwhelming sense of impending doom.
A man makes a deal with the devil to ensure the success of his newspaper.
A US naval destroyer investigates a mysterious tapping sound coming from a sunken submarine.

programmes.st: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programmes.d: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

programmes.st: Stopover in a Quiet Town (aka Strangers in Town)
programmes.d: Bob and Millie wake up to find they are in a strange town. Everything appears to be props - trees, animals even cars.
A pair of newlyweds stopping in a small town are trapped by their own superstition when playing a fortune telling machine in a local diner.
Little Anthony Fremont controls an entire town with his ability to read minds and make people do as he wishes.

programmes.st: The Old Man in the Cave
programmes.d: A mysterious guardian helps a tiny community survive after the Bomb destroys much of the Earth.
Jess-Belle enlists the aid of a local witch who casts a spell that makes Billy-Ben fall in love with her.
Before he died, notorious gunslinger Pinto Sykes put a curse on hired-gun Conny Miller. Miller returns to town and is challenged to visit the grave of Sykes, despite the curse.
A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.
Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.

Awakened by the cries of their daughter Bettina, Chris and Ruth Miller enter her room to find that she has vanished - even though they still hear her crying for help. Chris' physicist friend Bill thinks she moved into another dimension.
Using the power of mind over matter, Archibald Beechcroft remakes the world to his own specifications.
Before leaving on his mission, an astronaut meets a woman. They fall in love...
A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.

programmes.st: The Four of Us are Dying
programmes.d: A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.
A lonely man falls in love with a mini museum doll, which he believes is alive.
A man and a woman, on opposite sides of a future war, encounter each other in a deserted town.

programmes.st: The Night of the Red-Eyed Madman
programmes.d: U.S. agent James T. West enlists in a secret army of fanatics whose demented leader is plotting to overthrow United States Army units stationed in the Southwest.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Human Trigger
programmes.d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon go after Dr. Cadwallader, demented geologist who is systematically devastating the state of Wyoming with man-made earthquakes.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Torture Chamber
programmes.d: Gov. Bradford and his secretary, Miss Piecemeal, watch as the governor's statue is unveiled during a private showing at the Bolt Museum. Suddenly, the statue blinks, and Bradford, immobilized by an injection, is taken prisoner.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Howling Light
programmes.d: U.S. secret agent James T. West is lured into a hospital where he is gassed and carried out in a coffin by the weird, zombie-like aides of one Dr. Arcularis.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Fatal Trap
programmes.d: Secret agent James T. West poses as a notorious desperado, Frank Slade, inaplan to arrest a Mexican bandit, Colonel Vasquez, who has been robbing banks in American border towns and then fleeing to the sanctuary of Mexico.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Steel Assasin
programmes.d: Iron Man Torres strangles a shop owner named Gilbert as secret agent James T. West passes by.
Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon set out to crack a thriving opium-and-alien smuggling operation in San Francisco and become involved in struggle for control of Hunan Province, China.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Flaming Ghost
programmes.d: Secret agent James T. West is investigating the loss of government suppliers of kerosene and copper when his stagecoach is halted by a sheet of flame.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Grand Emir
programmes.d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon, assigned to protect a Middle Eastern despot from assassination, find their task complicated by the attitude of the degenerate tyrant, Emir El Emid.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Whirring Death
programmes.d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon help Governor Lewis keep the state of California solvent by seeing that a pledged $5,000,000 from each of three wealthy but disreputable personsis turned over to the governor.
Two U.S. Supreme Court Justices have died mysteriously but Justice Chaynedis misses secret agent James T. West's concern for his life.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Bars Of Hell
programmes.d: Secret agent James T. West poses as a Federal prison inspector and his side-kick, Artemus Gordon, pretends he is a preacher when the two are assigned to halt an organized outbreak of terror that has paralyzed a western community.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Two-Legged Buffalo
programmes.d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon are assigned to protect South Seas island prince who insists on going to an exclusive health resort where assassins are waiting to kill him.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Druid's Blood
programmes.d: Secret agent James T. West, probing the murder by fire of one of his former professors, Dr. Robey, a distinguished archaeologist, is ordered off the case at the request of U.S. Senator Hungerford.
Posing as a notorious hired gunman and a corrupt colonel, secret agents James T.West and Artemus Gordon infiltrate the forces of renegade-army leader Thorald Wolfe.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Burning Diamond
programmes.d: Secret agent James T. West is asking the Serbian minister to place his country's fabulous Kara diamond in federal custody until the International Jewel Exhibit opens, when suddenly the gem's case explodes and the jewel disappears.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Murderous Spring
programmes.d: A tall, powerfully built girl, Kitten Twitty, registers at a hotel and secret agent James T. West carries her trunk to her room, not knowing it contains his archenemy—diminutive, giggling Dr. Loveless.

Sully contemplates his own loneliness.
Doc confronts a horrible deed he's kept hidden for years.
Yokas, Bosco, Sully, and Davis fearfully search for a cop killer.

Sullivan is suspended and charged with improper conduct.
