Cuando la perforación de prueba de Claudia y Robin en busca de jade se queda vacía.
Un vendedor local de chatarra consigue hacer un ventajoso trato con Robin.
El equipo se esfuerza por subir el equipo pesado por un sendero de 120 kilómetros.
La tripulación intenta transportar su maquinaria a través de ríos crecientes.
Alan está convencido de que hay jade debajo de un pozo lleno de agua en su reclamo de Dinastía.
Robin trata de desafiar las leyes de la física con la construcción de una barraca gigantesca.
La mala suerte persigue a la tripulación de Jade City, y todos piensan soluciones distintas.
Después de una travesía difícil, Claudia y equipo de Robin llegan a la montaña Wolverine.
Robin y Alan comprueban si el jade extraído puede venderse en el mercado chino.
Claudia y su equipo hacen un llamamiento a Steve para que los ayude a salvar la temporada.
La temporada de Jade está a punto de terminar y parece que no van a alcanzar el objetivo.
Las heladas de invierno se están acercando y el equipo aún no ha dado con la veta de jade.
Las máquinas de Claudia y Robin comienzan a averiarse en el brutal trayecto hacia la mina.
La tripulación intenta cruzar ríos crecidos mientras marchan con sus máquinas hacia la mina.
Josh se queda varado en el largo sendero que conduce a la mina de Wolverine.
Guy y R2 luchan para conseguir cualquier gramo de jade y Alan les hace una propuesta.
Guy queda a cargo de Wolverine. Claudia y Robin establecen los objetivos de esta temporada.
Jay sufre un colapso que deja al descubierto las fallas de su preparación para emergencias.
Un arsenal de rocas sin valor impulsa a Claudia a considerar una nueva estrategia minera.
Alan lleva a un grupo de compradores a Jade City y el equipo de Claudia entra en pánico.
Josh corre el riesgo de perder 1 millón de dólares tratando de sacar su camión de un pozo.
El equipo encuentra la mejor roca de jade de la temporada, pero corre el riesgo de socavar su valor.
Justin, el hijo de Claudia, demuestra que tiene olfato para el jade.
Robin y Justin hacen una última búsqueda desesperada para ir a buscar rocas de jade.
Ciudad de Jade se ve amenazada cuando el tanque séptico retrocede hacia el agua potable.
La presión para el equipo aumenta: deben encontrar la pieza de jade antes del final de la temporada.
Con la roca más prometedora del año bajo las sierras de Wolverine, Josh y R2 chocan su camión.
El frío y la nieve ponen en peligro el intento del grupo por abandonar el campamento.
Claudia se ve obligada a conducir el camión de rocas mientras su equipo lucha por el sendero rocoso.
Los Bunce se esfuerzan para llegar a su campamento de jade en Wolverine.
Los Bunce montan un nuevo campamento minero con la esperanza de impresionar a sus socios.
La primera gran roca de la temporada se lleva al campamento y se coloca debajo de la sierra.
Justin se apresura a reclamar lo que le pertenece, luego de tropezar con un asombroso hallazgo.
Justin y el equipo se distraen intentando mover una gigantesca roca que podría valer una fortuna.
Después de discutir con sus socios de negocios, Claudia y Robin corren para reiniciar la minería.
El equipo se esfuerza por poner en marcha la cantera de jade de la dinastía.
Justin y Mike luchan entre sí tratando de demostrar sus métodos a los impacientes inversores.
Alan les da a Justin y Mike una dosis de realidad sobre el jade que están extrayendo.
Justin y Mike luchan para llegar a la "Gran Aleta", la única losa de jade de gran valor.
El invierno llega a Dynasty y la tripulación lucha por la mía hasta el último minuto posible.
Al financiar sola su temporada de minería y decidida a comenzar su búsqueda de jade un mes antes, Claudia se ve obligada a repensar su estrategia.
Robin sigue una corazonada sobre un nuevo sitio en un antiguo reclamo.
Guy lucha con la excavadora para exponer un hallazgo enorme.
La tripulación se enfrenta a una peligrosa recuperación en las orillas del río Turnagain.
Recortar un posible hallazgo de un millón de dólares queda en suspenso cuando falla un equipo antiguo.
El corte finalmente comienza en la lente de jade gigante en Dynasty, pero grandes fracturas cortan la lente.
Los aguaceros amenazan la seguridad de la tripulación y cierran la minería en el Pozo 3.
Cuando un importante comprador de jade no queda impresionado con la lente Pozo 3, Claudia se ve obligada a tomar una decisión difícil.
La carrera para preparar el campamento en Wolverine se convierte en una pesadilla.
El brutal viaje a una nueva mina separa a la familia y lleva a Josh al límite.
Claudia está ansiosa por comenzar a construir el nuevo sitio.
Los pequeños lujos en el campamento animan a un equipo descontento y los visitantes sorpresa aumentan las esperanzas de Claudia.
Gary y Josh no regresan de una búsqueda rutinaria de combustible y los núcleos de perforación ponen en duda la calidad de las lentes de jade en 2 Mile.
La tripulación finalmente logra un gran éxito, pero con el invierno acercándose, a Claudia le preocupa que el gran hallazgo haya llegado demasiado tarde.
Claudia está desesperada por comenzar a minar, pero las brutales condiciones del camino la hacen preguntarse si la tripulación logrará llegar a su reclamo.
Mientras Guy y Gary se apresuran a arreglar el camino destrozado hacia el reclamo, Claudia espera que un nuevo miembro de la tripulación sea el billete de la suerte.
La juerga de compras sorpresa de Robin estresa a Claudia cuando sus errores de compra retrasan la temporada minera.
Claudia intenta mantener la paz cuando Robin y su padre chocan, mientras el equipo lucha por solucionar un problema tras otro en su camión minero.
Gary y Josh están frustrados por una serie de crisis, mientras Claudia hace un anuncio impactante que descarrila los planes de Robin y provoca un conflicto entre la pareja.
Tensions boil over between Robin, Josh and Steve about how to mine and when Claudia steps in, things get downright explosive.
Plagados de problemas con los camiones, Robin y su equipo corren para hacer un suministro de combustible antes de que el equipo se agote.
Robin choca con Claudia y Josh por la calidad del jade que sale de su pozo, mientras que el intento de Larry de ayudar a llevar el barracón de la tripulación al campamento fracasa.
Claudia y su equipo están decididos a seguir minando a pesar de los incendios forestales que arden alrededor de su reclamo, hasta que las cosas empeoran y tienen que correr para salir.
Después de perder dos semanas de minería en los incendios forestales, Claudia y Robin corren el riesgo de regresar a Two Mile y apostar por la apertura de un nuevo pozo.
Claudia se estresa tratando de preparar su mejor jade para los compradores, mientras la moral de su equipo se pone a prueba mientras luchan contra el frío.
Claudia hace todo lo posible para intentar hacer una gran venta a los compradores de jade, mientras en la mina Guy y Gary luchan contra la primera tormenta de nieve de la temporada.
Claudia presiona a su equipo para que siga minando a pesar de las gélidas temperaturas y el deterioro de las condiciones de las carreteras.
La temporada de Claudia comienza con fuerza cuando recibe un pedido de jade por valor de 250 000 dólares.
Después de años de obtener la parte dura del trato con Scrappy Larry, Robin le hace una broma a su viejo amigo.
Bajo presión para cumplir con el ajustado plazo de su comprador, Robin y Josh chocan cuando se topan con interminables problemas.
Cuando una avería grave amenaza con cerrar la mina, Claudia y Robin toman la arriesgada decisión.
Josh evita por poco el desastre al entrar a la mina con una carga de combustible y Claudia queda devastada.
Claudia y Robin se apresuran a encontrar una segunda roca de jade antes de que su comprador abandone el trato.
Claudia recurre a su padre Steve en busca de ayuda cuando teme que la mayor venta de su carrera minera se le esté escapando de las manos.
La tensión surge entre Claudia, Robin y Josh mientras hacen un último intento por cerrar un trato con un comprador de Vietnam.
Mover una enorme losa de jade pone a prueba el antiguo equipo de la mina y la paciencia de Josh.
Arrastrar una roca de 20 toneladas por el peligroso camino para salir de la mina resulta demasiado para su viejo camión 6-Pack.
Robin descubre una enorme lente de jade en Two Mile, pero podría ser demasiado grande para que su pequeña operación la excave.
Cuando una extraña tormenta de nieve en agosto deja a Claudia y Robin varados en Two Mile, Gary y Garon intentan salvar el día conduciendo a través de la tormenta.
Robin toma una decisión difícil sobre su querido camión minero 6-Pack después de otra costosa avería.
Con el invierno acercándose, Claudia lleva a su exhausto equipo al límite, provocando que los ánimos se caldeen.
La nueva temporada minera está llena de sorpresas desagradables, pero un rescate improbable salva el día.

Tayler and Patrick's happy domesticity is disrupted when Tayler's mother, Jane, returns.
Grace, Jaz, Marcus, and Frank go to the city to confront the Minister responsible for a dam proposal.
Jaz is taken aback when Lily reveals her dad, Frank, is talking about proposing to her.
The district Yard Dog trials are fast approaching when Ben is befriended by a border collie.
Jaz is surprised to discover her horse has been personally delivered by Mischa.
Concerned that Jaz is getting caught up in Mischa's scheme, Grace threatens to report him to the officials.
Repercussions occur when, Ted Franklin, causes problems for Drovers Run and Tayler digs up gossip about him.
Grace discovers some of the new cattle have been stolen, Tayler poses as Ingrid's assistant after a mistake.
Ingrid's husband Paul is investigating the cattle theft, and Phil has planned a special evening for Moira.
After being shot, Ingrid's husband Paul is determined to get his wife and nobody will stand in his way.
Rehearsals are in full swing as Moira prepares to play the leading girl in Phil's musical.
Hit hard by the drought and facing a growing debt, the very future of Drovers Run is at stake.
With the land of Drovers Run on the line, Stevie musters all her determination to do the impossible.
Half-sisters Tess and Claire are reunited when they take over the family ranch after their father's death.
It's shearing time and one of the men arrives with a reputation as a killer.
Jealousies arise as Claire competes in the rodeo while Nick and Alex compete for Tess's attention.
Claire buys a pen of undernourished sheep from the stock sales, leaving Tess to question her judgment.
Tess's confidence is shaken after she falls from her horse.
Tess learns that Drovers Run is mired in debt and she confronts Claire.
Claire must pay off a debt to Harry Ryan, who has his eye on Drovers Run.
When Claire's new mare runs off with a wild stallion, Alex and Nick offer their help.
The hunt for a boar that is threatening the livestock disrupts life and throws Tess's skills into question.
Emotional and traumatic events of the past and present return to haunt the lives of the women of Drovers Run.
Meg struggles to cope with the reality of JodI’s coming of age.
Jealousies and family tensions between the Ryan brothers suddenly come to light.
Claire and Tess save a neighbour from a burning shed, but all is not as it seems.
Theft is on everyone’s mind and the women on Drover’s Run have their own style of justice.
When Claire attends a seminar on artificial insemination with Alex, she leaves Tess in charge of Drovers Run.
The sudden death of local farmer Max Martin alarms Harry prompting fears of his own mortality.
The girls are ready to celebrate with a night at the pub and a bit of Karaoke.
Claire is finding it difficult to come to terms with Tess's new found relationship with Alex.
When a good-looking itinerant Italian rescues Jodi from a rampant steer she falls hopelessly in love with him.
Tess believes she can discover the real reason behind everybody’s behaviour.
Tess is delighted when Simon and Briony, two old friends, show up for an unexpected visit.
Jodi is in the final stages of arranging a charity polo match.
Peter check on Claire's progress training the quarter horses, and their flirtation takes a new turn.
Tess and Alex's relationship is put to the test when a baby is abandoned on his doorstep.
Becky is thrown from her horse and injured when someone takes a shot at her.
It's a dry spell and the women are suffering shared baths, stained washing, and unflushed toilets.
Meg is thrown into turmoil when her first love, ex-husband Kevin (Jodi’s father) returns after 18 years.
Meg is faced with the decision to stay in the place she loves or to leave with the man she loves.
Claire and Peter's growing relationship is leaving Tess feeling more and more isolated from her sister.
Claire and Peter move closer to marriage when he presents her with a ruby pendant.
Claire's relationships are fragmented.
Claire is taking the loss of Peter and Tess badly.
Becky's troublesome older brother Mark returns, determined to drag Sean into his life of illegality.
Twenty-six-year-old Jyoti is the smallest woman in the world.

programmes.d: Two-year-old toddler Charlotte weighs only seven pounds.
Fifty-eight-year-old Ronnie and Donnie Galyon need round-the-clock care.
Conjoined twins Maria and Theresa were declared doomed when they were born.
Kendra and Maliyah Herrin were born attached at the abdomen and pelvis.
Follow three sets of conjoined twins and their lives after separation.
Defying doctors' grim diagnoses, Kenadie focuses on the best possible life.

Three of the tallest teenagers in America discuss their various challenges.
Follow the incredible story of three girls who have stopped aging.
A woman's arm burns from the inside out.
Doctors try to diagnose a mystery condition that has deformed a man's head.
A man is born with his heart outside his rib cage.
A man with cold-like symptoms loses his limbs and lips.
A teenager with a scale-like skin condition is desperate for relief.
A teenage girl sleeps for weeks at a time and an artist gets a bionic arm.
A man with a leg that weighs more than 200 pounds seeks a diagnosis.
A man with a crippling skin condition lives life on his own terms.
Doctors attempt to separate a pair of conjoined twins at the head.
A man with half a torso learns if his rare bone-eating disease is back.
A man whose body is eating itself hopes surgery can save his life.
A baby born with eight limbs undergoes groundbreaking surgery.
A woman hopes a tooth transplant in her eye will stop her from going blind.
An eleven-year-old boy is 6-feet-9-inches tall and still growing.
A woman who cries blood is desperate for a diagnosis.
A man's body blows up like a balloon after a diving accident.
A young boy lives with an agonizing skin condition.
A teenager hiding a rare condition hopes surgery will lead to normal life.
A man has thousands of bubble-like growths covering every inch of his body.
A man with a life-threatening face tumor must conquer his fear of surgery.
A man has surgery on a huge tumor, and a woman with a giant leg finds love.
A boy with undeveloped legs walks on all fours.
A full-face transplant patient battles a second life-threatening challenge.
A woman suffering from cyclical vomiting syndrome searches for a cure.
A woman's face is slowly being destroyed by a tumor.
Irish twins' muscles and flesh turn to bone.
A man's maimed hand is sewn into his stomach to avoid amputation.
Parents of a 44-pound baby try to learn why their son can't stop eating.
An eight-year-old with a form of dwarfism visits a specialist for answers.
A woman whose knees bend backwards faces a series of complex operations.
A man attempts to have a large facial tumor removed with a risky surgery.
A boy has legs that have become so large he is unable to move.
A man born with four legs finds out whether two can be surgically removed.
A mathematician born with severely deformed legs walks on all fours.
A man with branch-like growths covering his hands and feet seeks treatment.
A family struggles after their daughter is diagnosed with schizophrenia.

Amazing people tell the story of how they died and lived to tell about it.

Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.
Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.
Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.
Robin Williams headlines this joy ride of comic lunacy about a car salesman who must face a jealous husband.

Greetings, Earthlings. A pint-sized extraterrestrial has just landed on Earth by accident...and he's feeling a little, well, alienated because he got separated from his family. But MAC will transform the lives of everyone he meets...forever!
A host of stars voice this delightful animated tale of a dog sent back to Earth from Heaven.
Those lovable mutts Charlie and Itchy return for an all new animated, musical adventure!
To save her family from a farmer's plow, a mild-mannered mouse has a plan to move her house!
To prove himself, Igor, a mad scientist's assistant, creates a sweet, show-tune-singing monster.
Three singing caballeros blaze a side-splitting trail across the western frontier!
A wayward teen finds comfort and friendship with the military dog of his deceased older brother.
A gritty look at friendship, loyalty and ambition set on the rough streets of South-Central Los Angeles.
Christian Bale delivers a powerful performance as pilot Dieter Dengler, a prisoner in the Vietnam war.
Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.
Action-packed spy thriller about mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.
Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated tycoon who pulls off a stunning bank heist. Co-starring Faye Dunaway.
This comedy gem introduces Jacques Clouseau, the clumsiest Inspector ever to trip over a case!
Bumbling Inspector Clouseau must find a high-profile culprit quickly, or his career will be finit!

programmes.t: The Return Of The Pink Panther
programmes.d: When the Pink Panther Diamond is stolen from a museum, the intrepid Inspector Clouseau is on the case.
Chief Inspector Dreyfus is finally driven mad by Inspector Clouseau's (Peter Sellers) incompetence.
Peter Sellers’ comedic genius shines when the hapless Inspector Clouseau is presumed to be dead.
When boozing Monty's mother-in-law leaves him an inheritance, he must change his ways before he can collect!

Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage…and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) -- a loving husband, father and good cop -- is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.
Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

When it comes to laying down the law, one man can make a difference! Action superstar Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson takes no prisoners as he fights for justice and crushes corruption in this story of one man who takes a stand and takes back his town!
In this action-packed sequel, Kevin Sorbo discovers the quiet town he grew up in is now overrun by a violent gang. And it's up to him to take it back!

Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.
Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

The Calvin Finishing School for Girls is closed for Christmas vacation.  However, Mrs. Jensen (the housemother), five teenage girls and their mischievous male companions are all that remain at the school...or are they?
It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!
Facing a mound of debt, an devious undertaker and his reluctant assistant devise a wickedly funny plan to make death pay...by creating customers!
Virtuoso of horror Vincent Price ("Tales of Terror") dials up the depravity in this spellbinding trilogy of Nathaniel Hawthorne's chilling classics!
The legendary Vincent Price turns in another classic performance in this intelligent and grim thriller about a magistrate who just might be possessed.
Vincent Price buries his disfigured brother alive, but the body is dug up by a doctor (Christopher Lee). Still alive, the brother seeks his revenge.
A scientist commits a series of murders in his quest to create a race of super humans. Vincent Price, Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing star.
When a washed-up horror actor (Vincent Price) agrees to do a TV-series, the cast begin dying in ways similar to the deaths in the actor's old movies.

The eminent Dr. Phibes (Vincent Price) awakens from a decade of suspended animation and heads to Egypt with the corpse of his dead wife. Which he intends to resurrect by murdering people in strange and heinous ways to invoke a magical incantation!
Vincent Price is a crazed Shakespearean actor who adds murder to his repertoire when he takes gruesome revenge on the critics who slighted him.

Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!

Steve Railsback stars in this frightening journey into the unknown as a mission to investigate Halley's Comet discovers an alien craft whose seductive leader begins a terrifying campaign to drain the lifeforce of everyone she encounters!

Humans are such easy prey! H.P. Lovecraft's classic tale of suspense becomes "a grisly amalgam of sex, shock and satire" (Newsweek) in the hands of the creators of "Re-Animator." Jeffrey Combs and Barbara Crampton star in this cult-classic!
When a ice-blue meteor plunges through the sky and lands on a dairy farm, every living thing is infected and the farm owners change…hideously!

An English scientist entertains a young American visitor, serving up tea, terror and a beautiful daughter who is soon torn between her father's evil ways and protecting the man she loves. Boris Karloff stars in this H.P. Lovecraft adaptation.

When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.

A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.
In Paris, a theatrical company with a specialty in Grand Guignol undertakes their most gruesome production yet! And the blood will flow!
Shelley Winters puts the Grande in Grande Dame Guignol in director Curtis Harrington's atmospheric, suspenseful and surprisingly moving cult chiller.
In this terrifying sequel, the spirits of the dead are still hell-bent on luring the Freeling's daughter to the other side, where lies only evil!
Nancy Allen, Tom Skerritt, Zelda Rubenstein and Heather O'Rourke star in this suspense-filled conclusion to the terrifying "Poltergeist" trilogy.
Karen Black, Oliver Reed and Bette Davis star in this chiller as a family is surrounded by an evil  presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder.
Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult.

Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

programmes.t: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programmes.d: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.
Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun.

Twenty years after an unforgivable act, a pioneer has amassed immense wealth and a thriving mining town. But the blind ambition and greed that drove him to succeed finally catch up to him with the unexpected arrival of three apparent strangers.

As a train races through the Rocky Mountains, the passengers are being murdered! The only hope is John Deakin (Charles Bronson) who uncovers a secret that explodes in a torrent of shocking revelations, explosive brawls, and blazing gun battles.

Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.
Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.
Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.
In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother…who is blind.

When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.
John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.
Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.
Your Day 1 practice offers an invitation to slow down and take stock.

Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

Your day 3 practice invites you to get to know your body through the structure of the practice and the art of aligning. We build on day 1 and 2 with a focus on action and alignment through asana and energy.

As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.
There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.
Suffering has deep social causes. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains how your physiology is impacted by stress and social determinants.

The team, led by Anand, prepare for their motorcycle adventure to the four sacred peaks. The first practice ride is here in the birthplace of yoga, but it is not encouraging as monsoons are destroying roads and villages, Fred seems a liability and Ryan's seizures could be an issue.

Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

Emptiness and Power in the Gap. The stunning Tungnath Peak at 13,000 ft, the Feminine Temple above the Masculine. Ken goes from rational doubter to having an experience beyond understanding that relates to his deceased sister. Unfortunately, the experience is tainted by ignorance and the seemingly inspiring day is further marred when Anna has an accident…

programmes.d: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

Lisa Garr talks with Dr. Dain Heer, co-founder of Access Consciousness. Many of us suffer from a feeling of having to please others or conform to outside pressures. He shares his ideas on how to live authentically & his new book “Body Whispering.”

Lisa Garr talks with anti-aging experts Debra Poneman and Ronnie Newman about the importance of lowering stress for health and vitality. They also share simple meditation exercises and healthy recipes.

Lisa Garr talks with expert numerologist Glynis McCants. Known as “The Numbers Lady,” she talks about the history of Numerology as a numbers system and as a science used by Pythagoras forward. She explains about your life path & your personal year.

Lisa Garr talks with Nadine Artemis, founder of natural skin care company Living Libations, about how most “natural” beauty products contain traces of chemicals. Artemis believes that each plant has a certain vibration which can be used in healing.

Lisa Garr talks with author and spiritual teacher Sadhvi Bhagawati Saraswati about knowing when to trust a deep, inner calling. She was completing her Ph.D. at Stanford when she left America to live in India, where she has been for over 25 years.

Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.
Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.
There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.
After his son dies by suicide, a father seeks answers for what is killing today's youth.

The last two surviving members of the Piripkura people, a nomadic tribe in the Mato Grasso region of Brazil, struggle to maintain their indigenous way of life amidst the region's massive deforestation.

programmes.d: The films investigates the controversy swirling around the breast cancer screening test mammography.

Alcohol is the world’s most powerful drug. Four billion people drink it regularly and the number is rising. Of the world’s 30 countries with the highest per capita alcohol consumption, no fewer than 26 are in Europe. Big business with 3 million victims each year. But who profits from all this?

Bread is a branded product with an endless number of varieties and providers. But do we actually know what we eat every day? We meet small craft bakers who stand up for their quality and we meet CEOs who work on bread as an industrial mass product which becomes increasingly artificial. How can traditional bakery skills survive? And how will the future of bread look like?

A woman lets a close friend into her home, not realising that she is jeopardising her relationship.

Sophie Williams, the pregnant daughter of a billionaire chief, is on the verge of being duped and killed in exchange for all her inheritance after trusting the wrong people.
The constant argument between a young couple threatens to break their bond, leaving them wondering if love is enough.

AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A mother-in-law joins forces with her non-confrontational daughter-in-law to chase away the desperate ex-lover who is about to ruin her son.

Trapped in a toxic engagement, Oluchi’s world is turned upside down when her new neighbour, Brad, offers her refuge. As their bond grows, she must choose between enduring pain and risking everything for love and freedom.

In the quest of getting a man to impress her nosy sister and brother in-law, Pearl gets entangled with Kennedy, who pretends to be Pearl's blind date, Jerry, someone she has hired to help her out. When Pearl finds out this lie, she kicks Kennedy out of her house but they keep crossing paths.
When swinging couple, Angela and Michael, move into a new neighborhood, their promiscuous lifestyle becomes a sick charade and spins out of control.
After years of being alone, believing they have missed out on love, two people, who are old in years but young at heart, find each other.
An airport luggage mix-up causes a chance meeting between Pamela and Lawrence, which leads to connections and consequences that changes their lives forever.
A lawyer and a company owner's son navigate a complex relationship, initially marked by tension. Their connection unexpectedly deepens, while a hidden agenda threatens their burgeoning romance.
Worried that some illegalities are going on in her father’s company, a lady goes undercover to investigate and uncover the truth and finds herself in an entanglement she didn’t see coming.
Tired of her brother constantly sab otaging her relationships, Stella decides to find something to keep him busy but her plans backfires.

AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Hilda and Obinna instantly bond over the fact that they were both dumped unexpectedly by their respective partners, on the same weekend. Their commiseration turns into a mission when they see that their exes have happily moved on to new romances via social media. Desperate to win their loves back, they hatch up a plan to put an end to their exes' new relationships and send them running back to their arms.
The feud between two families has a devastating effect on the relationship between two best friends.

A young man's plan for marriage is thwarted due to him being unemployed and not having a home of his own. Whilst this is going on he is pressured by his family to take more responsibility for his life.
When being friends with benefits is no longer enough, what do you do? A woman falls in love with her male best friend but has to watch him dating other women.
Tony's perfect life is derailed when his old girlfriend, Dami, shows up unannounced at his doorstep with a surprise in tow.
A tenant's unpaid rent creates unexpected tension, leading to misunderstandings and surprising confrontations.

AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Christian and Olivia, a married couple, are torn apart when Olivia catches Christian having an affair with her younger sister, Sophia. This revelation leads to fatal results, but it is soon discovered that things are not quite what they seem.
A man working hard to provide for his family faces conflict with his girlfriend when she tries to come in between him and his friend and business partner.

An insurance executive (Linda Fiorentino) skips town with drug money and stops at nothing to get what she wants.
After a series of misfortunes, a woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) with an unfaithful boyfriend (John Lynch) experiences an alternate reality.
An asylum escapee (Larry Drake) plays doctor on a killing spree, then decides to do a heart transplant.
An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.
An evil archaeologist tries to exploit five pygmy dinosaurs that hatched in a family's basement.
A banker who moonlights as a call-girl falls in with a sadistic undercover officer (Steven Bauer), a money launderer (Christopher Walken) and his wife (Joan Chen).
A 1920s playboy returns from a stint in the French Foreign Legion to reclaim his lover, a mobster's mistress.
A young GI (Ethan Hawke) and his squad have a strange encounter with Germans in the Ardennes forest, December 1944.
While on a desert excursion, a family encounters cultists who use human hands as sacrificial offerings to their god.
An innocent half-Asian kickboxer is caught between two other races at war in prison.
A kickboxer must prevent the launch of a nuclear missile by terrorists targeting New York.

A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.
A banker who moonlights as a call-girl falls in with a sadistic undercover officer (Steven Bauer), a money launderer (Christopher Walken) and his wife (Joan Chen).

A young woman flees New York City after being implicated in a murder and moves to Los Angeles, where she rents a room from a writer. They begin an affair, but it seems she's been followed by a homicidal duplicate of herself.
A fast talker (Eric Tsang) engages a Hong Kong rube (Jet Li) to track down the assassin of a sleazy Japanese businessman.
A Jewish cop faces a crisis of conscience when he learns a shopkeeper may have been killed by an anti-Semitic group.
A writer (Cary Elwes) moves into a wealthy family's guest house and befriends a precocious 14-year-old daughter (Alicia Silverstone).
A lumberjack helps a tribe of rain-forest elves protect their kingdom from an evil spirit and greedy clear-cutters.
A small-town sheriff (Nick Nolte) becomes unhinged, thanks in part to his abusive, alcoholic father (James Coburn).

La tragedia de los incendios en Colombia expone la precariedad de los cuerpos de Bomberos: escasez de personal, equipos deficientes y falta de recursos impiden atender emergencias, dejando comunidades desprotegidas y vidas en riesgo.

Hogares convertidos en escenarios de violencia. Historias de arrendatarios que ocultan secretos, mientras familias vulnerables enfrentan tragedias impensables. En un país donde el arriendo es necesidad, la confianza se paga con vidas y silencio.
Los venezolanos que cometen delitos en Colombia generan un polémico debate sobre qué hacer.

Ana, víctima de abuso por su profesor, ve justicia tras años de denuncias. Judith, asesinada en Bogotá, revela una red criminal. Valentina, presunto suicidio, resulta ser homicidio. Angelie, con Diamond Blackfan, recibe un trasplante exitoso. Harvey, policía herido, lucha por su recuperación y justicia.

El 13 de marzo de 2015, en Villa Lozada, La Plata, Huila, cuatro miembros de la familia Ramírez fueron brutalmente asesinados. Aunque inicialmente se sospechó un atraco, la investigación reveló que el crimen fue obra de una banda dedicada al apoderamiento ilegal de terrenos en Ciudad Bolívar, quienes buscaban el millonario botín que la familia guardaba, producto de su negocio de comercialización de café.

En 2010, en Putumayo, Myriam Zamora fue acusada de asesinar a sus dos pequeños hijos e intentar suicidarse. Aunque ella se declaró víctima y refutó las acusaciones de la Fiscalía y de su esposo durante el proceso, no logró presentar pruebas que respaldaran su versión. Sin evidencia que sustentara su inocencia, fue condenada y pasará varios años tras las rejas.

El 17 octubre del 2015, en el corregimiento de Belén, en El Banco Magdalena, dos hombres abusaron y asesinaron a Valeria Peña, una menor de 15 años que logró sobrevivir antes los ataques y dejar un testimonio donde señalaba a José Fernando López como el autor material de su crimen. Sin embargo, un tercer testimonio involucro al hermano de José Fernando y el autor intelectual quien tenía claras intenciones de venganza.

En 2007, María Cecilia Viva Salas desapareció en Buenaventura, generando conmoción en su barrio. Inicialmente se sospechó de pandilleros, pero la investigación reveló que su esposo Harvey era el responsable. Su hija Pilar, testigo silenciada por miedo, finalmente reveló pistas clave. El rastreo del celular llevó a su cuerpo, hallado en su propia casa. Harvey confesó y fue condenado a 18 años, aunque salió libre tras cumplir la mitad de la pena.

Deibis Mildred y Adolfo González formaron una familia y un negocio exitoso de confecciones en Riohacha. En 2008, Adolfo fue asesinado en su casa, un crimen inicialmente sin resolver. Tres años después, las sospechas recayeron sobre Deibis Mildred, señalada de planear el homicidio junto a un amante para cobrar un seguro de vida. Fue condenada a 40 años de cárcel como coautora del asesinato.

En 2008, Nidia Yazmín González, madre soltera de 37 años, fue hallada muerta en el río Gámeza, Boyacá, con signos de brutal violencia. Mantenía una relación secreta con Alirio Castro, un hombre casado, posesivo y celoso. Pruebas clave —su cinturón negro en karate y un historial de maltrato— lo señalaron como responsable. Absuelto en 2009, la fiscalía apeló y en 2011 fue condenado a 33 años de prisión.

Giovanny Padilla, registrador en La Jagua de Ibirico, fue asesinado el 1 de enero de 2018 en Valledupar. Dos jóvenes, Emanuel Castro y Jesús Sánchez, lo torturaron para robarle. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados.
Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.
Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.

Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.
Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

En la Guajira, Maye rescata niños víctimas de explotación sexual. Carlos Iván vive con el Síndrome de Prader-Willi, mientras que un grupo de jóvenes colombianos construyen con llantas en China, mostrando talento y sostenibilidad.

Elaine Palacio, la única modelo colombiana en portadas de Vogue Italia y ángel de Victoria's Secret, nació en Puerto Boyacá enfrentando racismo y baja autoestima. A los 15 años se fue a Medellín y luego a México, donde fue víctima de explotación laboral, viviendo con solo 40 dólares mientras cargaba una deuda ficticia. Se reinventó, recuperó su carrera y fundó "Negros de Corazón" para impulsar a jóvenes afrocolombianos.

¿Por qué Q, de 21 años, y Alicia, de 55, no tienen sexo más a menudo? Entonces, Jenny se enamoró de un hombre 10 años menor que ella y ha estado encontrando fotos de mujeres desnudas en su teléfono, pero ¿le ha estado engañando?

¿Antonio ha sido infiel a Chasity desde el día de su boda? ¿Mike se está acostando con Lisa, la madre de su esposa? Jackie asegura que Danny es infiel y él asegura que ella lo es... ¡Maury tiene todos los resultados!
Lanikka está harta de los abusos de su novio Malcom. Después, los celos de Tim han destrozado su familia, pero ahora está desesperado por recuperarlos, ¿Tiffany lo dejará definitivamente?
Pamela quiere pesar 40 libras. Samantha, que sufre de bulimia y alcoholismo, roba para consumir sus atracones. ¿Pueden las dos mujeres lidiar con sus desórdenes alimenticios con apoyo y tratamiento?

Melody cree que su novio Glenn contrató a Marra para lavar coches en bikini y acostarse con él. Glenn sospecha que Melody también le ha sido infiel. Además, Dani no está segura de si su novio Robert se acostó con su hermana.

Kiki y Kat eran compañeras de trabajo que se enamoraron. ¡Pero ahora Kat dejará a Kiki por un hombre! Después, Cedric viene a decirle a su novia que quiere llevar su relación a otro nivel... y a otra persona.
Tashe quiere la verdad sobre su novio y otra mujer; Frank tiene una revelación que pondrá el mundo de su novia patas arriba; Passion se pregunta si debería darle a su novio un trío.
Brady le propone matrimonio a su exnovia, pero ella se entera de que él la engañó con su amiga; Dillon siente que debe confesar que le hizo una insinuación a la amiga de su prometida.

León no siente más que desprecio por la novia de su hermana, pero se encuentra cometiendo un acto impensable con ella; Brenda teme que un romance con Erika pueda arruinar su amistad; Jenny quiere confesarle un error a su hermana.
La amiga de Ariana quiere que deje a su novio por él; Samantha se declara en huelga porque teme que su novio la engañe.

T-Jay dice que es hora de compartir su profundo y oscuro secreto con la mujer con la que ha estado saliendo; Natasha quiere casarse con el padre de su bebé, pero él es miserable en la relación; el novio de Sasha traicionó su confianza.
Las agencias de viajes se aprovechan de los clientes con ofertas de ensueño que se convierten en pesadillas.

En Cajicá, Marta Ávila dejó de pagar arriendo y se negó a desalojar la casa de Stefan y Ana Gonzenbach. En Montería, la finca de Adriana Gómez fue invadida por familias tras ser desalojada por paramilitares. En Armenia, Weimar González invadió los lotes de Edgar Vélez y Juan Diego Zapata.
Dos niños con dificultades médicas tienen un sueño por cumplir.
Carmen fue engañada por un hombre que conoció en línea después de querer una vida mejor para su hijo.
Los adultos mayores colombianos están perdiendo casas y negocios por ser estafados por sus abogados.

Tres hombres, acusados injustamente de abusos, luchan por su libertad tras años de cárcel y sufrimiento. A pesar de pruebas que demuestran su inocencia, la verdad tardó demasiado en salir a la luz. ¿Quién paga por el daño de una falsa denuncia?

En La Virginia, Risaralda, Heidy Yuliani Restrepo, una niña de 11 años, desapareció el 31 de diciembre de 2013 y fue hallada muerta días después en un caño. La investigación señaló a su propia madre, María Preselia Martínez, como responsable del crimen, motivado presuntamente por la pérdida de una sim card. Fue condenada por homicidio agravado y cumple su condena en la cárcel de mujeres La Badea, en Pereira.

En Florencia, Caquetá, Lina, embarazada de siete meses, fue asesinada frente a su casa. Aunque el sicario escapó, un testigo señaló a Marmolejo, pareja de la víctima y padre de su bebé, como el autor intelectual del crimen. Pruebas contundentes, incluyendo el testimonio del propio pistolero, confirman que Marmolejo contrató el asesinato para deshacerse de Lina y estar con otra mujer.

Alberto Elías Orozco, empresario dueño de la fábrica "Yogurozco" en Cali, fue asesinado junto a su esposa Macclly Arbeláez en marzo de 2012 cuando se dirigían a misa. Tras varias hipótesis, se descubrió que su propio hermano, Juan Carlos, contrató sicarios para matarlos, motivado por la codicia y el deseo de convertirse en el único heredero de sus bienes.
Heidy Guzmán, de 10 años, desapareció en Tolima en 2007. Fue hallada sin vida tras dos semanas. La investigación reveló abuso y homicidio.

Jessica Mayerli Alza, una estudiante de 16 años, es hallada desmembrada dentro de una maleta en el sur de Bogotá. La investigación reveló que Andrea, su mejor amiga, la asesinó al descubrir que Jessica sostenía una relación con su esposo, Leimar. Autoridades sospechan que Andrea tuvo cómplices en el crimen. Un año después, Andrea Valdez Contreras fue condenada a 345 meses de prisión por homicidio agravado.

Óscar es asesinado en su cuarto. Al principio parecía suicidio, pero su amigo Yeison fue arrestado y reveló que la ex esposa, Paola, lo mandó matar por el seguro. Yeison recibe 17 años de cárcel. Paola proclama su inocencia.

Olga Lucía Gaviria y su hija María Ángel fueron asesinadas en Medellín en 2010. El padrastro, Edilson de Jesús Taborda, fue condenado a 60 años por celos enfermizos tras pruebas forenses que lo vincularon al doble homicidio.
Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.

Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.
Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

Los Wilson demandan a Sean Moore, patrocinador de Ballpark Bandits, por 10.000 dólares. Su hijo fue despedido a mitad de temporada, Sean culpa al comportamiento errático de Kevin y a Laurie por fomentar la negatividad e intimidar a los padres.

Lola, del icónico programa infantil Plaza Sésamo, comparte cómo ella y el equipo de producción se adaptaron a la pandemia mediante video llamadas para seguir conectando con los niños. También hablan sobre los programas humanitarios de la organización, incluyendo su iniciativa más reciente para ayudar a los niños refugiados sirios desplazados por más de una década de guerra en Medio Oriente.

Luz Mary y Yon Fredy, tras perder tres embarazos, esperaban con ilusión a su bebé Salvador. En medio del paro nacional de 2021 en Colombia, con un embarazo de alto riesgo, quedaron atrapados en un bloqueo de manifestantes en el peaje de Sisga camino a Bogotá. Aunque finalmente los dejaron pasar, ya era demasiado tarde: perdieron a su bebé y con él, todas sus ilusiones de ser padres.

Michael dice que él y Britny no tuvieron relaciones sexuales lo suficiente como para que ella quedara embarazada. Shekeita y su hermana Natasha están aquí para demostrar que Kieary es el verdadero padre del bebé de Shekeita.

Monica tenía una relación con Deshan. Pero él y su madre, Tayama, afirman que solo fue una aventura de una sola vez. Más tarde, los rumores impiden que Joshua reclame al hijo de Deshan, ¡Joshua Jr.! ¿Quién es el padre biológico de Joshua Jr.?

Nicola and Risky attend an elderly woman suffering a suspected heart attack, who’s more concerned about letting her friends down than her own perilous health.

The air ambulance crew rush to a frightened car crash survivor whose memory loss has Matt concerned. Mark must keep his emotions in check as he treats a toddler with severe burns, whilst trying to reassure the distressed parents. A mysterious young woman found unresponsive on a bus has Carina baffled as to what’s wrong. Risky and Nicola attempt to help a 60-year-old with a broken wrist, but are confronted by an unwanted intruder who escalates the situation.

Mark races to help a young father of three who’s in danger of losing his arm, which got caught in a factory conveyor belt. After a car crash leaves a trail of destruction and several walking wounded, Nat and Leonard are shocked by a patient’s surprising revelation. Matt takes charge of a precarious rescue in mountain ranges, where a driver is trapped in his car. Amanda rushes to help a sick baby, but quickly succumbs to his infectious smile.

At Australia’s Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Emma West faces a dangerous situation with an aggressive stabbing victim. The patient will die without help, but he’s putting up a fight. Drs Jonathan Papson and Mya Cubitt race to save the life of a young man whose car slammed into a pole. Dr Mark Putland treats a factory worker who’s in shock after being confronted with his horrific life-changing injuries. A heavily pregnant young woman presents a challenge for Dr Michelle Thornhill.

A gunshot victim arrives at The Royal Melbourne Hospital under police guard. Dr Sarah Whitelaw fears the patient could die from his injuries, but the shooter is still at large, posing a risk. Dr Jonathan Papson treats a football player who could bleed to death from kidney damage, after an on-field collision. Dr Michael Dunne and nurse Lucy Stranger assess a pregnant car crash patient who can’t feel her baby move. Dr Michelle races to the waiting room after a woman mysteriously collapses.

Dr Fiona Nicholson uses her reassuring bedside manner on a young man with a racing heart and spiking blood pressure - but she’ll have to stop his heart beating in order to save him. A patient with a gruesome head wound has Dr Sarah Whitelaw on full alert, and unseen internal injuries could make things even worse. Nurse Julia Hoiles helps a smitten young couple who spend their first date in emergency. Dr Michael Dunne treats a nurse-to-be who has smashed her leg in a car accident.

A spate of road accidents puts pressure on the emergency team. Dr Mark Putland tries to help a car crash patient, but the man appears to be hiding something suspicious in his underpants. Dr Miriam Yassa examines a cheerful 82-year-old biker with fractures, who suddenly takes a turn for the worse. Dr Emma West’s road trauma victim could have internal bleeding, but the cure could do more harm than good. Nurse Yasna Cardoza helps a patient who collapses after cutting his thumb on a coffee plunger.

Dr Mark Putland assembles a crack team to save a man with a gunshot wound to the neck with a rare procedure to keep him breathing. Dr Jonathan Papson suspects a surf-coach has a shattered leg from a horror car crash, which could spell the end of the young man’s career. A worker is in agony after a fall on the job, and Dr Sarah Whitelaw and nurse Maddy Whyte fear he has serious spinal injuries. Dr Mya Cubitt heals a former boxer with neat stitches and helps him confront an unpleasant truth.

After lengthy repairs and inspirational pep talks, the qualifiers prepare to fight for the title. A 10-way Robot Rumble will give the victor a spot in the Grand Finals, alongside the heat winners.

Robot fightings newest competition begins! In the first heat, meet new robots and some familiar faces as teams get a feel for the arena and size up their competition. Filmed in Grantham in front of a live audience, robots battle for survival in the Robots Live Arena.

Heat 2 of the UKs most brutal robot combat competition takes the action to Crawley in the south of England. Winners and losers from Heat 1 face fresh opponents, fighting to secure a win and guarantee their place in the finals.

Its the last chance for teams to secure a spot before the final. In savage and tactical 1v1 matches, teams battle for a place in the top 16. New robots join the fray, hoping for a last-minute victory to advance to the championship.

The most battle-hardened combat robots in the UK compete in the MechMania Grand Final. After three grueling heats, only the toughest survive. The tournament is now a single-elimination, 1v1, sudden-death formatuntil one team emerges as the victorious champion.
The first of sixteen Heats in the seventh series. The four-way melees kick off the competition with true carnage. Sir Killalot may have changed the tide of battle during the finals.
The second round of heats sees eight new robots join the fight for The Seventh Wars title. Growler is de-muzzled as he rampages through the arena in the four-way melees, no-one is safe.
After the four-way melees, the house robots do not hesitate to get involved with the remaining competitors. A counter-attack leads to one of the shortest finals robot wars has ever seen.
An equal number of newcomers and veterans take to the battlefield in this episode, experience versus vigor in today’s heats. The innocent Refbot gets attacked after cease is called.
The Sixth Wars champions return to the arena to battle for the Seventh Wars title. Do they still have what it takes to win, or will the competition be too fierce this time round?
A newcomer from Germany joins the UK competitors in this week’s heats. Will they put show the UK how it’s done, or will the other robots have a home advantage?
Another German joins the roster this week. One robot becomes an eviction technician, removing their opponents from the arena. Refbot joins the fray as he helps pit an immobilised robot.

A robot representing the Netherlands fights with the Brits in this heat. After attempting to attack one of the house robots, Growler makes an example of one of the competitors. Matilda uses her flywheel in spectacular fashion.

One hapless robot gets expertly dismantled by another competitor, leaving Refbot to count them out. Maybe the house robots should take notes. A Hail Mary charge leaves yet another robot out of the arena.
The Seventh Wars continues, eight more robots with high hopes of becoming champion enter the arena. One robot has to see a man about a dog, as Mr. Psycho and Growler team up on a competitor.
Only one team can win the £20,000 cash prize, and they could be competing in this week’s heat. A close first round leaves it up to the judges to decide who will progress through the heat.
A newcomer has an aggressive start to their first battle, with no competitor or house robot left unchallenged. Will they make it all the way to final or be punished for their hubris?

Transporter, Ranger and Talon face a potential nuclear disaster. Will the team prevent meltdown, or will this challenge prove too explosive for them?
The water pressure’s rising and if the team don’t get there soon the whole of Calamity City will be underwater. Will the team sink or swim?
A series of major fires have broken out on the outskirts of Calamity City. Will the team extinguish the inferno before it blows it destroys all in its path?
A satellite with vital scientific data has crash landed in the desert. Will the team be able to retrieve it safely, or will the information be lost forever?

A featherweight battle between this week’s rounds. Robots that weigh no more than 12kg battle to join the other qualifiers. The main competition proceeds as evenly matched robots do anything they can to get the upper hand.
Canada and Switzerland both battle in the World Championship Qualifier special event. The heats near their end and spots for the final are filling up rapidly and to a high standard.

It’s all-out war as Refbot is immobilised and Sir Killalot may have finally met his match. One round ends exceptionally quickly. Another World Championship Qualifier between three Dutch robots is this week’s special event.

The last of the heats, the final eight robots that have a chance of making it to the Grand Final, will they seize the opportunity or choke under the pressure? A featherweight champion will be revealed in this week’s special event.

Eight of the heat winners gather for the first Semi-Finals. With two rounds to prove themselves, only two robots will make it to the Grand Finals. Competitors show no mercy as they use any means necessary to eliminate their opponents.

One competitor’s weapon proves fatal for their opposition, crushing their hopes of a title with a single blow, whilst other unlucky robots are removed from not only the arena, but also the competition.

The Grand Final is here as the series draws to an explosive end. With every battle being so well matched, the judges have their work cut out for them as they decide which robot, will become Robot Wars: The Seventh Wars champions.

Twelve Robots from across the globe once again gather in the arena for the Third World Championship. Eliminator style rounds will decide which robots progress through to the finals, where a winner will be crowned.
Four more stars team up with professionals to test their battle ability. Will it lead them to fame and fortune, or will they end up being thrown to the curb along with the other scraps?

Soo finally reunites with Gae Ttong and promises to marry her. However, Hoon realizes he has feelings for her. Meanwhile, his investigation into the Rogue's death leads him closer to the truth.

Realizing Gae Ttong is in danger because of his father, Hoon agrees to arrange her marriage to Soo. Meanwhile, Flower Crew begins the difficult task of transforming Gae Ttong into a proper noble lady.

Gae Ttong continues her training to become a noble lady. Joon helps Lady Yim and realizes his memories of his mother were wrong. Meanwhile, the Chief State Councillor discovers that Soo has been deceiving him.
Gae Ttong suddenly confesses her love to Hoon. While Hoon tries to avoid her, Soo grows anxious after overhearing them. He meets Lady Kang and asks Lord Kang to speed up the royal wedding.
Hoon and Gae Ttong confess their love, but a marriage ban is declared until after the royal wedding. Meanwhile, Lord Kang investigates Flower Crew and discovers Young Soo's true identity.

Hoon tells Soo that his marriage to Gae Ttong is canceled. Lady Kang forces Gae Ttong into the queen selection process using her secret against her. At the palace, Gae Ttong finally learns Soo's true identity.

Furious over Soo and Hoon's deception, Gae Ttong refuses to remain a noble lady. But Moon Seok warns that many lives depend on her becoming queen. After a beautiful day with Hoon, she prepares to say goodbye.
Gae Ttong enters the second queen selection, but an astrologist claims she has the fortune of the dead. Soo discovers a political scheme, while Kang and Young Soo are taken in for interrogation.
The Chief and Second State Councillors plot treason. Gae Ttong is kidnapped to force Hoon's cooperation, while Young Soo is imprisoned. Joon uses all his resources to find where they are being held.
Flower Crew, Joseon's top matchmaking agency, consists of Ma Hoon, Young Soo, and Do Joon. While working on a case, they meet Gae Ttong. Soon after, blacksmith Kim Soo asks Flower Crew for help.
Flower Crew agrees to arrange Gae Ttong and Soo's wedding. Everything goes smoothly until Soo suddenly disappears. Gae Ttong and Hoon set out to find him, but their search seems hopeless.
Hoon allows Gae Ttong to join Flower Crew as a three-month apprentice. After losing clients, the crew takes a case involving scholar Lee Hyung Gyu, but Hoon suspects he is hiding something.

Hoon lets Gae Ttong stay at the house again, and subtle feelings grow between them. Gae Ttong promises to leave if she fails to persuade Scholar Lee. Meanwhile, Soo orders an investigation into the Crown Prince's murder.

Hoon is taken to the palace and discovers that Soo is now the king. Soo asks him to protect Gae Ttong. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong volunteers to pose as a noble lady to help Flower Crew with Scholar Lee's marriage.
Hoon is flustered by Gae Ttong's unexpected kiss, but she remembers nothing the next morning. Meanwhile, Scholar Lee asks her to deliver his napchae documents to his bride's home, but she refuses.

In the Bible, Saul persecuted Christ's church and its followers. Overcome parallels this story. Set in modern day, a young man in high school mistreats anyone good around him, until he has a fateful accident which changes his life. Now he must make amends to all those around him, and try to become the person he knew he should have been the whole time.

When The Dovers find they’re in financial jeopardy, the only answer is to sell the house Anne’s parent’s left her. But when no one wants to buy it, they decide the only way to get rid of the house is to fix it up.

When Trish Harper is late for a blind date due to Daylight Savings time, she mistakenly meets Parker, a thoughtful paramedic. But even though there's a spark between them, when she discovers her error she keeps him at arms-length, focusing instead on her thriving bakery. But ever so slowly, she begins to fall in love...
Two people meet on Black Friday, get separated, and yearn to reunite—if only they knew each other’s last names and numbers. Can destiny help them find each other by Christmas?

A friend of Kevin and Willie has not one, but two work trucks that need improvements for hauling heavy loads.  Can the guys handle this double-order and finish both trucks in time for the owner to get them back on the job?
